jobs.title: Senior Clinical Reimbursement Specialist
jobs.excerpt: At Veracyte, we offer exciting career opportunities for those interested in joining a pioneering team that is committed to transforming cancer care for patients across the globe.
jobs.description:
At Veracyte, we offer exciting career opportunities for those interested in joining a pioneering team that is committed to transforming cancer care for patients across the globe. Working at Veracyte enables our employees to not only make a meaningful impact on the lives of patients, but to also learn and grow within a purpose driven environment. This is what we call the Veracyte way – it’s about how we work together, guided by our values, to give clinicians the insights they need to help patients make life-changing decisions.

Our Values:

  • We Seek A Better Way: We pursue bold ideas, embrace complexity, and keep pushing forward.
  • We Make It Happen: We act with urgency, deliver with excellence, and always find a way.
  • We Are Stronger Together: We engage with empathy, align around what's best for Veracyte, and celebrate as one team.
  • We Care Deeply: We show up with integrity, kindness, and respect for one another.

The Position:

We are seeking an experienced Senior Clinical Reimbursement Specialist to serve as a clinical subject matter expert on our Clinical Reimbursement Operations team. In this role, you will independently manage complex pre- and post-service appeals, mentor junior team members, and drive process improvements that measurably improve overturn rates and revenue capture across the revenue cycle.

You will apply advanced clinical judgment and deep payer policy expertise to handle the team's most complex, high-dollar, and precedent-setting cases - including Level 2 appeals, external reviews, and payer escalations. Beyond individual casework, you will contribute to workflow design, SOP development, and cross-functional initiatives that strengthen the team's overall performance.

Success in this role requires advanced knowledge of reimbursement systems (including payer utilization management and claims adjudication), fluency in payer medical policies, sound and independent clinical judgment on complex cases, and the ability to influence outcomes through both direct case ownership and informal leadership.

Primary Duties and Responsibilities

  • Independently manage complex pre- and post-service appeals across Level 1, Level 2, and external review pathways, including the review, development, and submission of clinically robust appeal documentation.
  • Serve as a clinical subject matter expert on payer medical policies, translating complex policy criteria into patient-specific clinical justification and guiding appeal strategy for high-dollar, ambiguous, or precedent-setting cases.
  • Own end-to-end resolution of assigned cases, including follow-up, coordination with ordering providers, and appropriate escalation to leadership when warranted.
  • Partner with ordering physicians and practice staff to coordinate peer-to-peer reviews, gather supplemental clinical documentation, secure Authorized Representative forms and signatures, and support collaborative initiatives that strengthen appeal outcomes.
  • Mentor and provide informal guidance to Clinical Reimbursement Specialists, including case review, appeal letter quality feedback, and coaching on payer policy interpretation.
  • Lead analysis of denial patterns and appeal outcomes to identify root causes, and drive upstream feedback to reduce future denials.
  • Contribute directly to the development and refinement of appeal letter templates, clinical evidence packets, payer reference guides, and other scalable operational tools.
  • Monitor payer behavior and policy changes across all lines of business; flag material changes and partner with leadership on remediations, coverage reviews, and payer escalations.
  • Support the maintenance and continuous improvement of SOPs, ensuring workflows remain consistent, compliant, and scalable as the team grows.
  • Serve as point of contact for complex patient- or provider-facing inquiries, ensuring accurate, empathetic, and compliant communication.
  • Support digital transformation initiatives, including automation and AI/agentic workflow pilots that improve appeal readiness scoring and clinical documentation review.
  • Represent the Clinical Reimbursement team in cross-functional initiatives and special projects that support evolving reimbursement and operational priorities.

Who You Are:

Qualifications

Required

  • Active clinical licensure (e.g., RN, NP).
  • Associate or Bachelor's degree in nursing.
  • 3–5 years of experience in healthcare reimbursement, revenue cycle operations, or payer-facing roles.
  • 2+ years of experience in prior authorization, denial management, or appeals -including pre-service and post-service workflows.
  • Advanced understanding of payer medical policies, prior authorization, claims adjudication, denials, and appeals - including Level 1, Level 2, and external review processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage complex, ambiguous, or high-dollar cases without routine escalation.
  • Proven ability to translate complex payer medical policy criteria into patient-specific clinical justification.
  • Strong critical thinking and analytical skills, including the ability to interpret incomplete denial information and drive appropriate next steps without direction.
  • Experience contributing to the development of SOPs, appeal letter templates, workflow tools, or other operational assets within a reimbursement environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor or provide informal leadership to peers, including case review, coaching, or SME support.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional discussions and convey clinical/reimbursement concepts to both clinical and non-clinical stakeholders.
  • Demonstrates ownership of cases through resolution, including follow-up, coordination, and appropriate escalation.
  • Comfortable working in an evolving environment with shifting priorities, ambiguity, and the need to build systems where none exist.

Preferred

  • Prior experience in oncology diagnostics, laboratory services, or complex/specialty reimbursement environments.
  • Experience leading or contributing to process improvement, workflow redesign, or operational scaling initiatives within the revenue cycle.
  • Familiarity with digital transformation initiatives in healthcare operations (automation, AI/agentic workflows, workflow tools, system integration).
  • Relevant certification (CPC, CRCR, CHFP, Lean/Six Sigma) or Master's degree (MSN, MHA, MBA).

The final salary offered to a successful candidate will be dependent on several factors that may include but are not limited to years of experience, skillset, geographic location, industry, education, etc. Base pay is one part of the Total Package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work, and this role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives, and restricted stock units.

Pay range
$86,098—$107,850 USD

What We Can Offer You

Veracyte is a growing company that offers significant career opportunities if you are curious, driven, patient-oriented and aspire to help us build a great company. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, and are committed to fostering an inclusive workforce, where diverse backgrounds are represented, engaged, and empowered to drive innovative ideas and decisions. We are thrilled to be recognized as a 2024 Certified™ Great Place to Work® in both the US and Israel - a testament to our dynamic, inclusive, and inspiring workplace where passion meets purpose.

About Veracyte

Veracyte (Nasdaq: VCYT) is a global diagnostics company whose vision is to transform cancer care for patients all over the world. We empower clinicians with the high-value insights they need to guide and assure patients at pivotal moments in the race to diagnose and treat cancer. Our Veracyte Diagnostics Platform delivers high-performing cancer tests that are fueled by broad genomic and clinical data, deep bioinformatic and AI capabilities, and a powerful evidence-generation engine, which ultimately drives durable reimbursement and guideline inclusion for our tests, along with new insights to support continued innovation and pipeline development. For more information, please visit www.veracyte.com or follow us on LinkedIn or X (Twitter).

Veracyte, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer and will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status or disability status. Toloka AI supports frontier model post-training by building domain-specific reinforcement learning environments, tasks, and evaluation frameworks designed by real practitioners.

Mindrift, powered by Toloka — a leading enterprise AI and machine learning data partner since 2014 — connects top domain experts with cutting-edge AI initiatives. Backed by Toloka’s deep expertise in scalable data generation, crowd technology, and applied ML systems, Mindrift enables experts to shape how next-generation generative models learn, reason, and perform.

We are launching a Management Consulting domain focused on translating real-world consulting engagements into structured learning environments for advanced AI systems. To do this credibly, we are assembling a team of strategy consultants from top-tier firms who can convert authentic project experience into end-to-end examples — from problem structuring and work planning to analysis, synthesis, and client-ready recommendations.

You will join a growing team of consultants from leading strategy firms shaping how AI learns high-level business reasoning.

Important: This role is exclusively for consultants with direct experience at a top-tier strategy consulting firm. If you do not have hands-on project experience at one of the firms listed below, please do not apply. This requirement ensures the domain is built by practitioners trained to the highest standards of structured problem-solving and client delivery.

Eligible firms: McKinsey & Company, Boston Consulting Group (BCG), Bain & Company, Oliver Wyman, Roland Berger, Monitor Deloitte (Deloitte S&C), EY-Parthenon, Kearney, and Strategy& (PwC).

Who We’re Looking For

Consultants with 3+ years of experience at one of the firms listed above, with hands-on project experience in:

  • Structuring ambiguous client problems into workable analytical plans
  • Building financial models, market analyses, or synthesized findings from messy inputs
  • Producing client-ready deliverables under time pressure
  • Forming and defending recommendations under uncertainty

No deep technical background is required — we will onboard you on the lightweight tools involved.

What You’ll Do

  • Build realistic consulting project environments — create detailed project scenarios grounded in real engagement dynamics: industry context, financials, constraints, conflicting inputs, and incomplete information.
  • Design structured consulting tasks for AI agents — break projects into discrete tasks that mirror real consulting work: market sizing, commercial due diligence, cost optimization, growth strategy, operational diagnosis, benchmarking, and more.
  • Define evaluation criteria and quality standards — develop grading frameworks, evaluation rubrics, and golden-answer solutions for each task, used to train and calibrate an LLM-based grading system that evaluates AI outputs at scale.

This is a remote, project-based, individual-contributor role focused on analytical design and evaluation.

Skills & Requirements

  • 3+ years at McKinsey, BCG, Bain, Oliver Wyman, Roland Berger, Monitor Deloitte, EY-Parthenon, Kearney, or Strategy&
  • Strong structured problem-solving and hypothesis-driven thinking
  • Ability to translate vague problems into clear analytical steps and deliverables
  • High attention to logical consistency and output quality
  • Independent, self-directed working style
  • Clear written English (B2+)

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $60 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 25-30 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active. Tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet the listed acceptance criteria to be accepted.

jobs.excerpt: 💫Про RIA. com Ми — українська продуктова ІТ-компанія RIA.
jobs.description:
💫Про RIA.com


Ми — українська продуктова ІТ-компанія RIA.com, яка розвиває відомі маркетплейси AUTO.RIA, DIM.RIA, AGRO.RIA та RIA.com.
Нашими продуктами користуються мільйони українців, тож команда фахівців наполегливо працює над покращеннями та пошуками інноваційних рішень.

👥 Про команду

AUTO.RIA допомагає безпечно купувати та продавати нові та вживані авто. Маркетплейс збирає 9 мільйонів користувачів щомісяця, а кількість завантажень застосунку перевищує 29 мільйонів разів.

Ми шукаємоiOS Developer (Senior), щоб підсилити команду, яка розвиває напрям вживаних авто.

Понад 80 спеціалістів із різною експертизою працюють разом, щоб створювати найкращий досвід для користувачів. Ми керуємося гнучкою методологією Agile, чіткими цілями за системою OKR і тримаємо у фокусі постійне покращення продукту.

🔷Які цілі стоятимуть перед тобою:

  • разом із командою розвивати та масштабувати мобільний додаток AUTO.RIA;

  • проектувати та впроваджувати складні архітектурні рішення, тримати під контролем модульність системи;

  • брати активну участь у розробці нових фіч і покращенні поточного функціонала;

  • проводити якісний Code Review та менторити колег, поширюючи найкращі інженерні практики;

  • тестувати та впроваджувати нові технології, інструменти та підходи.

⚡️Що для нас важливо:

  • Досвід розробки: від 4 років комерційного досвіду з Swift (UIKit + SwiftUI);

  • Архітектура та проєктування: практичний досвід побудови та підтримки Modular Architecture (SPM-модулі, dependency graph, межі feature-модулів) та застосування патернів (TCA, MVVM, Coordinators/VIPER);

  • Асинхронність та мережі: впевнена робота з async/await, Combine, REST API, WebSocket, GraphQL та push-сповіщеннями (включаючи Silent Push/VoIP);

  • Дані та навігація: досвід роботи з Realm та обробкою Deep Links;

  • Engineering Culture: досвід проведення якісного Code Review, здатність аргументовано обговорювати технічні рішення та впливати на архітектуру.

Буде перевагою:

  • Досвід написання Unit-тестів та налаштування CI/CD процесів;

  • Досвід роботи з технологіями та інструментами: Sign in with Apple, Apollo, Firebase, WebRTC, Nuke, RxSwift, SwiftPhoenixClient;

  • Інтеграція сторонніх API (Facebook, Google тощо);

  • Досвід роботи у продуктових компаніях.

🔗Про етапи інтерв’ю:

  1. Знайомство з рекрутером (30–45 хв) — знайомимося, обговорюємо твій досвід, очікування та деталі про команду.

  2. Intro-зустріч із Тімлідом та Лідером напрямку (45–60 хв) — технічна розмова та відповіді на всі твої запитання.

  3. Тестове завдання

  4. Фінальна зустріч (60 хв) — розбір тестового, детальний фідбек від команди та обговорення прийнятих рішень.


📌Що на тебе чекає в RIA.com?

  • Практичне втілення командних цінностей: відкрита комунікація, регулярні 1-on-1, фідбек, підтримка наставника із першого дня для швидкої адаптації, без мікроменеджменту чи тайм-трекерів.

  • Комфортні умови роботи: ремоут чи гібрид — вирішувати тобі. Комфортний офіс у Вінниці та за надзвичайних умов пропонуємо можливість працювати у зручній локації, витрати на яку покриває компанія, гнучкий графік роботи, офіційне працевлаштування.

  • Здоров’я та турбота про себе: онлайн-консультації корпоративного лікаря та підтримка ментального здоров’я з психологом, необмежена кількість лікарняних та 20 робочих днів оплачуваної відпустки, батьківська година (1 раз на тиждень).

  • Можливості розвитку: Performance Review з індивідуальним планом розвитку на рік, компенсація вивчення іноземних мов та професійного навчання, бонусна програма для підтримки хобі та відпочинку ріакомівців.

RIA.com — соціально відповідальна українська компанія. «Авто для ЗСУ» від AUTO.RIA — це фандрейзинговий проєкт, який офіційно працює з 2023 року. Завдяки активному залученню команди, креативним ініціативам і колабораціям із зірками та українським бізнесом, ми придбали та відправили більше 40 автівок: пікапи, позашляховики, тягачі та вантажівки для військових у найгарячіші напрямки.

Більше про те, як ми працюємо, можна дізнатися тут:

Віримо, що саме команда формує продукти, які стають лідерами ринку, тож чекаємо твоє резюме!

About Us

Today PebblePad is a leading ed-tech company partnering with top-tier colleges, universities, professional organisations, and credentialing bodies around the globe.

PebblePad helps educators combine the best of experiential learning and authentic assessment to bridge the gap between ambition and reality in ways traditional learning platforms cannot. We help higher education institutions create rich, meaningful, student-centered learning experiences that guide learners to prepare for, make sense of, curate, and showcase their learning journeys.

We are also one amazing team. We support one another, celebrate success together, and genuinely believe that enjoying what we do is part of making a difference.

About the Role

Reporting to the VP of Customer Success, the Head of Customer Success, APAC is responsible for executing the global Customer Success strategy across the region, translating it into clear regional priorities, performance, and outcomes.

The role is accountable for the health, retention, and growth of the APAC customer portfolio, ensuring customers realise value from their investment in PebblePad while identifying opportunities to expand their use of our products and services.

You will lead the regional Customer Success function, driving consistent, high-quality customer engagement and strong commercial performance, while operating within globally defined standards and contributing regional insight to inform broader strategy.

This role combines leadership, commercial accountability, and hands-on engagement, including ownership of strategic accounts and modelling best practice in customer success, stakeholder management, and commercial conversations.

What You Will Be Doing

Strategic Leadership

  • Execute and evolve the APAC Customer Success strategy in alignment with PebblePad’s global Customer Success vision and direction.
  • Translate global objectives into clear regional priorities, plans, and measurable outcomes.
  • Embed consistent customer success frameworks, processes, and engagement models across the region.
  • Use customer insight, health metrics, and performance data to proactively identify risks, opportunities, and required interventions.
  • Contribute regional insight and recommendations to global strategy, supporting continuous improvement of product, service, and customer experience.
  • Act as a senior advocate for APAC customers internally, ensuring their needs are represented in business decision-making.

Commercial & Portfolio Ownership

  • Own the health, retention performance, and growth of the APAC customer portfolio.
  • Accountable for achieving regional GRR, renewal performance, and expansion ARR targets.
  • Lead renewal governance, including risk identification and mitigation strategies across the region.
  • Maintain accurate forecasting and reporting, ensuring clear visibility of risks and opportunities.
  • Partner closely with Business Development to identify and execute land-and-expand opportunities.
  • Collaborate with Professional Services to drive service adoption, managed services opportunities, and commercial engagement.
  • Establish clear account planning standards and oversee execution across the team.
  • Personally manage a portfolio of high-value strategic accounts, acting as an executive sponsor and trusted advisor.

Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead and performance manage the APAC Customer Success team, ensuring delivery against globally defined standards for customer engagement, retention, and growth.
  • Set clear expectations and accountability across the team for portfolio management, forecasting discipline, and commercial performance.
  • Conduct regular 1:1s, performance reviews, and structured coaching to support both performance and development.
  • Support hiring, onboarding, and effective ramping of new team members.
  • Partner with the VP of Customer Success on leadership development, capability building, and ongoing team effectiveness.
  • Foster a high-performing, collaborative, and accountable team environment aligned to global ways of working.
  • Partner with the Senior Education Solutions Consultant on regional initiatives, ensuring activity is aligned to customer needs, regional priorities, and the broader Customer Success strategy.

Customer & Community Engagement

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with senior stakeholders across strategic customer accounts.
  • Lead executive business reviews, renewal discussions, and strategic account conversations.
  • Work hand in hand with the Senior Education Solutions Consultant to ensure regional services and engagement approaches meet the evolving needs of clients.
  • Represent PebblePad externally at conferences, webinars, and customer events.
  • Collaborate with the Global Community Lead to ensure community engagement translates into meaningful account-level outcomes.
  • Promote and amplify customer success stories, innovation, and best practice across the PebblePad community and wider sector.

Success Measures – Year 1

  • APAC GRR maintained at 95% or above.
  • Regional expansion ARR targets achieved.
  • 100% of APAC accounts health-scored within 90 days.
  • Renewal forecast accuracy of 90%+ within a 90-day window.
  • Increased Professional Services engagement and attach rates across the region.
  • Improved customer engagement and maturity across strategic accounts.
  • Strong team performance aligned to regional and global objectives.

About You

Essential Experience

  • Strong experience in Customer Success within SaaS, ed-tech, or enterprise customer environments.
  • Demonstrated success managing complex customer accounts, including multi-stakeholder environments and, ideally, multi-product portfolios.
  • Proven ability to drive customer retention, adoption, and value realisation across a diverse customer base.
  • Strong commercial awareness with experience supporting renewals, identifying growth opportunities, and contributing to expansion outcomes.
  • Skilled at building and maintaining trusted relationships with senior stakeholders within customer organisations.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Product, and Professional Services teams to deliver customer outcomes.
  • Data-driven, with the ability to use customer insights, health metrics, and reporting to prioritise activity and manage risk across a portfolio.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.

Leadership Capability

  • Demonstrates strong ownership, accountability, and sound judgement in managing customer relationships and business outcomes.
  • Able to guide, influence, and support peers, contributing to team performance and consistent ways of working.
  • Brings a structured and thoughtful approach to planning, prioritisation, and decision making.
  • Comfortable leading customer conversations at a senior level and representing the business externally where required.
  • Contributes positively to team culture, collaboration, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Experience managing or supporting team performance or development.

Nice to Have

  • Experience managing Customer Success teams within an ed-tech environment.
  • Experience working with multiple products or complex solution offerings.
  • Exposure to renewal forecasting, pipeline contribution, or commercial targets.
  • Experience presenting at senior or executive-level customer meetings.
  • Familiarity with CRM and Customer Success platforms (e.g. HubSpot, ChurnZero).

Additional Information

The role is full time and remote. Some travel will be required to customers, conferences, and company events. As an international organisation operating across multiple time zones, occasional work outside standard business hours will be required to support our global customers and teams.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Customs House Brokerage
jobs.excerpt: KlearNow. AI is an AI-native customs brokerage and trade compliance platform transforming how global enterprises clear goods and manage duty exposure.
jobs.description:
KlearNow.AI is an AI-native customs brokerage and trade compliance platform transforming how global enterprises clear goods and manage duty exposure. We serve major importers and logistics providers including Target, BASF, Hershey, and SLB, by replacing manual entry work and brittle rules engines with an autonomous ingestion and clearance pipeline. Our north-star metric is Zero Touch Rate: the share of shipments that clear end to end with no human intervention.

The Role

    We're hiring a Product Manager to own the Customs House Brokerage (CHB) product area, the core of what we do. You'll own the products that classify goods, build and validate entries, file to ABI/ACE, handle PGA and tariff logic, and get shipments across the border correctly and automatically.

    This is not a generalist SaaS role. You need real broker depth; enough to know when the system is right, when it's wrong, and when it's confidently wrong, because a plausible-looking error here is a seven-figure duty discrepancy waiting to happen. And you must be AI-native: someone who uses AI as their primary means of production and designs products that are agentic by default.

What You Will Own

    You'll own CHB end to end, from problem framing to shipped, measured outcomes. That spans classification (vector-DB retrieval with LLM fallback, citation and confidence scoring), entry construction and validation, ABI/ACE filing logic, PGA handling, and the tariff stack beneath it all: Section 232, Section 301, and the IEEPA/Section 122 layer including Chapter 99 stacking.

    Every manual touch our ops team makes is a defect in the product, not a fact of life. You'll find the exceptions eating human time and drive them out one workflow at a time, writing acceptance criteria in terms of what the system does with no human action required: the trigger, the automated behavior, the pass criteria, the failure modes. You'll co-own delivery with an engineering lead inside our Bet / Shape / Build / Validate pod framework, and ship prototypes as part of your thinking, not after it.

What You Bring

    Customs brokerage depth. You know the entry lifecycle cold: HTS classification, 7501, ISF, ABI/ACE/CATAIR mechanics, PGA, and post-entry work (PSC, PEA). You can hold a real conversation about 232/301, the current IEEPA/Section 122 landscape, and why the order of operations in a duty calc is not negotiable. A US broker license (or the field-earned equivalent) is a strong plus.

    Technical fluency. You understand how data moves through a platform, ingestion, extraction, APIs, integrations, and the difference between a deterministic rule and a probabilistic model. You can read a schema, reason about where a bug lives, and write requirements engineers respect. You prototype and query data yourself.

    Product craft. You've owned products end to end in a complex, high-stakes domain. You do real discovery, prioritize ruthlessly against a metric that matters, write crisp testable criteria, and ship on a cadence at the quality bar Target and BASF expect.

What "AI-Native" Means Here

    This part isn't negotiable. The bottleneck has shifted from producing artifacts to having the judgment to know what's right; and AI collapses the first 70% from weeks to hours. We expect you to work at that speed: use Claude to frame problems and pressure-test your reasoning, use Cursor / Lovable / v0 to get a working prototype in front of people in a session, and think in agentic terms because systems that retrieve, reason, cite, score their own confidence, and escalate only true exceptions are our product. We're not looking for someone who “has used ChatGPT.” We want someone whose default working mode already assumes these tools exist.

Nice to Have

    Prior experience at a customs brokerage, freight forwarder, or trade-tech platform. Familiarity with Canadian customs (CARM, CAD, LVS), restricted party screening, or refund/reconciliation workflows.

    The CHB product area is the engine of the company, and the person in this seat has an outsized hand in whether we hit exception-only autonomous clearance. If you want a role where the domain is genuinely hard, the AI is genuinely central, and the outcomes are genuinely measured, this is it.

Benefits

    KlearNow offers a competitive compensation package, including:

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Health Reimbursement Plan to off set deductibles and out of pocket medical expenses
  • Equity participation
  • 401K
  • Flexible time off policy (uncapped vacation without waiting on accruals)
  • This position is Remote (US only)
KlearNow is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees

When a 911 call is answered, a detective investigates a case, or a forensic lab processes evidence, there's a good chance our software is working behind the scenes. That's been true for over four decades.

AI is central to where we're going. Not as a feature but as core infrastructure. We're embedding intelligence directly into the workflows our customers rely on every day, and we're doing it alongside them. Our customers tell us what the mission demands. We build what answers it.

This work attracts a specific kind of person — someone who wants to be pushed by great people, build things that outlast a sprint cycle, and go home knowing the work connected back to something real.

  • Contribute to cross-functional strategy discussions and represent implementation expertise in organizational forums.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned to support team objectives and overall organizational priorities.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or a related field; advanced degree is an asset.
  • 8-10+ years of experience in software implementation, including leadership of advanced, enterprise-scale, or multi-phase projects.
  • Experience with Police Records Management Systems (RMS), especially with Versaterm RMS is strongly preferred.

jobs.description:
About the Show

Just N Life with Nekia Nichelle is a lifestyle and entertainment series that brings together meaningful conversations, culture, wellness, beauty, fashion, food, entrepreneurship and everyday inspiration.

The show combines the warmth of a lifestyle program with the energy of a modern talk show, creating content for broadcast, streaming, digital and social audiences.

Position Overview

We are seeking a creative, organized and resourceful Intern Producer to support the development and production of Just N Life with Nekia Nichelle.

This is a hands-on opportunity for someone interested in television, digital media, entertainment, journalism or content production. The Intern Producer will help move each episode from the initial idea to the final production by assisting with research, rundowns, guest coordination, scripts and production logistics.

This is not an internship where you simply observe. You will contribute to real episodes, real segments and a growing media production.

Responsibilities

Develop Show Ideas

Research timely lifestyle, entertainment and cultural topics that align with the voice and audience of Just N Life.

Pitch guests, recurring segments, demonstrations, interviews, products, trends and story ideas for upcoming episodes.

Build Show Rundowns

Assist with creating and updating episode rundowns, including segment order, timing, transitions, commercial breaks, production notes and talent cues.

Work with the production team to ensure each episode is organized and stays within its assigned runtime.

Research Guests and Topics

Prepare guest research, interview notes, background information, talking points and suggested questions for Nekia Nichelle and the production team.

Verify names, titles, company information, statistics and other details before they are included in the show.

Support Guest Coordination

Assist with guest outreach, confirmations, scheduling and follow-up communication.

Help collect headshots, biographies, social media handles, product information, release forms and other materials needed before production.

Assist With Scripts and Segment Preparation

Draft segment introductions, interview questions, transitions, host notes, promotional copy and production summaries.

Help organize scripts and supporting materials so the host, guests and production team are fully prepared.

Support Production Days

Assist with call sheets, guest check-in, production schedules, props, products, wardrobe notes, set preparation and other production needs.

Communicate updates to the appropriate team members and help keep production moving on schedule.

Organize Production Materials

Maintain organized episode folders containing rundowns, scripts, research, releases, guest information and production assets.

Ensure all files are properly named, updated and accessible to the production team.

Support Digital Extensions

Identify moments from each episode that can be repurposed for YouTube, social media, the Just N Life website and promotional content.

Assist with preparing titles, descriptions, timestamps, captions and clip recommendations.

Qualifications

  • Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in television production, broadcast journalism, communications, media, film, marketing or a related field
  • Strong writing, research and organizational skills
  • Genuine interest in lifestyle, entertainment, culture and digital media
  • Comfortable working with deadlines and changing production needs
  • Able to communicate professionally with guests, brands and team members
  • Detail-oriented and able to manage several assignments at once
  • Familiarity with Google Workspace, Microsoft Office or similar platforms
  • Familiarity with production rundowns, teleprompters, editing software or project-management systems is a plus
  • Previous experience with a student television station, podcast, YouTube channel, publication or production company is helpful but not required

What You Will Learn

  • How a television and digital show is developed from concept through production
  • How to create professional show rundowns and production documents
  • How producers research, book and prepare guests
  • How scripts, interviews and lifestyle segments are developed
  • How broadcast content is repurposed across digital and social platforms
  • How brands and products may be incorporated into sponsored programming
  • How to work within a professional media and production environment

What We Expect

We are looking for someone who is dependable, proactive and ready to contribute. You should be willing to ask thoughtful questions, accept feedback and take ownership of your assignments.

Confidentiality, communication and integrity are essential. Interns may have access to unreleased episodes, guest information, brand partnerships and internal production materials that must remain private.

This opportunity is ideal for someone who wants to build a real career in television, entertainment or media production—not someone simply looking to add another line to their résumé.

Schedule

This is a part-time internship. Availability may include virtual production meetings, independent assignments and scheduled production days. Some evening or weekend availability may be required based on the production schedule.

How to Apply

Please submit:

  • Your résumé
  • A brief statement explaining why you are interested in producing lifestyle and entertainment content
  • Any relevant writing, video, podcast, production or school-work samples
  • Your general weekly availability

Applications should demonstrate creativity, professionalism and a clear interest in helping build Just N Life with Nekia Nichelle.

Завдяки активному залученню команди, креативним ініціативам і колабораціям із зірками та українським бізнесом, ми придбали та відправили більше 40 автівок: пікапи, позашляховики, тягачі та вантажівки для військових у найгарячіші напрямки.

Більше про те, як ми працюємо, можна дізнатися тут:

Job Title: SAP Basis, Cloud and Compliance Lead (RISE & Enterprise Platforms)

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced SAP Basis, Cloud & Compliance Lead to own the architecture, delivery and governance of our SAP RISE and Cloud application landscape, supporting enterprise digital transformation. This role acts as the technical authority for SAP platforms, ensuring availability, resilience, security, compliance and operational excellence across global SAP environments.

The role partners closely with internal IT teams, SAP ECS, cloud providers and system integrators to proactively manage platform health, risk and continuous improvement while aligning SAP technology with business strategy.

Key Responsibilities

SAP Platform Architecture & Basis Leadership

  • Own and govern SAP platform architecture across ECC, S/4HANA, CRM, Solution Manager and RISE environments

  • Act as the SAP Basis and platform SME, defining standards, best practices and lifecycle management

  • Lead system refreshes, upgrades and S/4HANA readiness including pre and post refresh technical activities

  • Oversee batch job monitoring, background processing and interface stability

Cloud, RISE & ALM Governance

  • Architect and govern SAP RISE operations, shared responsibility model and hyperscaler alignment

  • Own SAP Cloud ALM strategy for monitoring, alerting, incident management and continuous improvement

  • Manage integrations across SAP and cloud ecosystems including Ariba, BTP, OpenText, Cloud Connector, DPA and third‑party platforms

  • Own connectivity design including VPNs, IP whitelisting, authentication and network coordination

  • Maintain understanding of SAP contractual services, SLAs and chargeable offerings and align changes with leadership

System Monitoring & Operational Excellence

  • Define and implement end‑to‑end SAP monitoring strategy covering availability, performance, capacity and interfaces

  • Establish alerting, escalation and incident response models aligned to business criticality and ITSM processes

  • Drive root‑cause analysis for recurring or major incidents and implement long‑term corrective actions

  • Ensure continuous platform health through proactive system checks, housekeeping and performance tuning

  • Lead capacity planning based on data growth, business demand and future roadmap

Security, Compliance & Risk Management

  • Ensure SAP platform compliance with IT General Controls (ITGC) and internal audit requirements

  • Partner with the Security team to drive FUE optimization, vulnerability remediation and secure configuration

  • Lead audit engagement, evidence preparation walkthroughs and remediation activities

  • Maintain SAP risk register covering availability, security, compliance and operational risks

Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity

  • Define and validate SAP disaster recovery architecture including RTO and RPO targets

  • Lead DR planning, testing and readiness reviews with SAP and cloud providers

  • Ensure business continuity through resilience design, failover readiness and recovery governance

Governance, Change & Stakeholder Management

  • Establish SAP platform governance frameworks spanning Basis, Cloud, Security and Compliance

  • Govern change, release, transport and environment strategies for BAU and project delivery

  • Develop and maintain operational runbooks, SOPs and escalation models

  • Communicate platform vision, risks and opportunities effectively to senior leadership

  • Act as a bridge between business stakeholders, SAP, vendors and internal IT teams

Key Skills & Experience

  • Strong experience in SAP Basis, RISE with SAP and cloud platforms

  • Hands‑on expertise with SAP ECC, S/4HANA, CRM and Solution Manager

  • Experience with Cloud ALM, system monitoring, DR planning and audit readiness

  • Proven knowledge of SAP integrations, connectivity, security governance and compliance

  • Experience working with SAP ECS, hyperscalers and system integrators

  • Ability to operate at both architectural design and operational leadership levels

We Offer

At HBK, we believe in freedom with responsibility, enabling a healthy work-life balance and continuous professional development. You will join an international team in an innovative and enjoyable working environment.

About HBK

On January 1, 2019, Brüel & Kjær and HBM merged to form HBK (Hottinger Brüel & Kjær). With over 3,500 employees worldwide, production facilities in Denmark, Germany, the UK, the USA, China, and Portugal, and a presence in 80 countries, HBK is a global leader in test and measurement solutions. EHR Deployment Engineer (Technical Practitioner)

Salary: $120,000 – $140,000 | Location: 100% Remote in California (semi-frequent travel) | Start: ASAP

The Deployment Engineer (Technical Practitioner) supports the full lifecycle of an Electronic Health Record (EHR) system implementation across multiple VA medical centers.

The Practitioner performs and organizes discovery efforts at hospitals and clinics related to End User Devices (EUDs), interfaced systems, and Data Drops & Power Outlets (DDPO), then conducts post-discovery analysis to inform technical scope and requirements. Building a working understanding of the client's standard capabilities, devices, and interfaces is essential to meaningful discovery and gap analysis.

Through the remainder of the deployment lifecycle, the Practitioner supports device procurement tracking and logistics, owns relationships with local site IT leaders and other technology/network/engineering groups, and supports overall technical readiness for the transition to a new EHR. This includes external vendor management and coordination, cutover planning and support, and project management of engineering activities.

Responsibilities

  • Track device procurement and coordinate logistics through deployment

  • Coordinate external vendors supporting site readiness
  • Support cutover planning and go-live execution
  • Manage and report on engineering activities against deployment milestones

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field; equivalent experience considered
  • Strong written and oral communication skills
  • Proficiency with MS Office Suite (Excel, Project, PowerPoint)
  • Willingness to travel semi-frequently to hospitals and clinics across various geographies

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with system interfaces and medical device interfaces

Working Conditions

Remote-first with semi-frequent travel to VA facilities. Significant direct client interaction expected. Must be based in California.

jobs.excerpt: SEO & Content Specialist / StrategistGrowth & Lifecycle Marketing | Full-Time, Exempt | Reports to Director of Growth & Lifecycle Marketing Do the work that makes Seeking the answer wherever daters search, scroll, and ask — hand-coded, hand-written, and shipped by you.
jobs.description:
SEO & Content Specialist / Strategist

Growth & Lifecycle Marketing | Full-Time, Exempt | Reports to Director of Growth & Lifecycle Marketing

Do the work that makes Seeking the answer wherever daters search, scroll, and ask — hand-coded, hand-written, and shipped by you.

Company Seeking.com (Reflex Media)

Location Remote (US).

Compensation $75,000 to $115,000 base, commensurate with experience and level. Performance and outcome-dependent incentive plan included.

Travel Required for team meetings, offsites, and project needs.

About the Role

Seeking.com is the world’s largest premium dating platform, and we are entering the most important chapter of our brand transformation. We are looking for an SEO & Content Specialist to own the day-to-day execution of Seeking’s organic content engine end to end as a hands-on operator: hand-editing HTML for on-page SEO, writing and shipping content, coordinating outside partners, and applying the tactics that earn brand visibility across traditional search, AI Overviews, and answer engines like ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and Perplexity.

This role is open at two levels: SEO & Content Specialist and SEO & Content Strategist. Level and placement in the salary band are determined by experience, depth in on-page SEO and content execution, and demonstrated ownership of end-to-end organic wins. The role is the same shape at both levels; the Strategist level carries broader scope, more autonomy, and higher expectations on discovery strategy, cross-channel synthesis, and mentorship.

This role may also be a fit for candidates whose current title is SEO Specialist, SEO Analyst, Content Marketing Specialist, Content Strategist, Organic Growth Specialist, SEO Copywriter, Editorial SEO Manager, Content SEO Manager, or Digital Marketing Specialist. If your day-to-day is writing content, editing HTML on the page, and moving pages up the SERP and into AI answers, you should apply regardless of your current title.

You will edit the HTML, write the content, brief the vendors, read the numbers, and rewrite the plan by Friday. You will report to the Director of Growth & Lifecycle Marketing and partner closely with Creative, Brand, Product, Data & Analytics, and outside agency and freelance partners.

Let’s be direct: we are not looking for a strategist who briefs the work to an agency and waits for the deck. We tried that and got senior operators who could not sit down and ship an on-page fix themselves. This role is for a builder who can log into the CMS in week one, audit how Seeking shows up across every surface that matters, hand-edit a page for on-page SEO, publish a piece of content, and coordinate an agency deliverable — all by the end of week two. If that is you, keep reading.

What You’ll Own

On-Page & Technical SEO Execution

  • Edit HTML and CMS templates directly to implement on-page SEO best practices: title tags, meta descriptions, header hierarchy (H1–H3), schema and structured data, internal linking, image alt text, and clean URL structure.
  • Run routine technical SEO health checks (crawlability, indexation, page speed basics, broken links, redirects) and either fix them yourself or coordinate the fix.
  • Maintain WordPress-based properties (Seeking blog, STNDRDS, and adjacent brands), keeping HTML clean, semantic, and shippable.
  • Implement structured data, schema markup, and entity tagging so search engines and AI answer engines can read and cite the page correctly.

Content Writing & Editorial Execution

  • Write, edit, and publish organic content — blog posts, landing pages, FAQs, category pages, and pillar hubs — aligned to defined content pillars and audience segments.
  • Ship content directly when speed, voice, or judgment require it. You are a writer as much as a strategist.
  • Contribute to and help maintain the editorial calendar across owned channels, and align it with brand campaigns, product launches, and cultural moments.
  • Identify content gaps, refresh opportunities, and topical authority angles, and turn them into published assets.
  • Develop entity-driven content strategies that give AI systems clear, authoritative, structured answers so Seeking is the source they cite.

Discoverability Across Search, AI Overviews, and Answer Engines

  • Run keyword research, intent expansion, and competitive discovery analysis using GA4, Search Console, SEMrush, and Ahrefs to inform content and on-page decisions.
  • Structure content and markup to earn visibility on AI-powered discovery surfaces, including AI Overviews, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).
  • Increase brand presence across Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, and the next wave of LLM-powered discovery surfaces, using clear, extractable, citation-ready formatting.
  • Stay current on emerging discoverability tactics and bring practical, tested recommendations back to the team.

External Partner & Vendor Coordination

  • Serve as the day-to-day point of contact for external agency and freelance partners supporting content, SEO, and production work.
  • Manage deliverable timelines, feedback loops, and quality checks for agency-produced content and SEO work. Hold the line on scope, brief, and quality.
  • Bring in outside skill where it makes the work better, but stay hands-on enough that no partner can outrun your understanding of the actual work.

Reporting & Cross-Team Collaboration

  • Track and report on the small set of KPIs that matter (organic traffic, rankings, indexation, engagement, and AI-search visibility) on a weekly and monthly cadence.
  • Translate performance data into next-cycle priorities. Flag risks early and route them to the right internal team.
  • Partner with Creative, Brand, Product, Legal, and other marketing functions to ship content and on-page changes on schedule and on-brand.
  • Support ad hoc organic growth initiatives (for example, reputation and review monitoring) as directed.

Required Qualifications (Both Levels)

  • Hands-on SEO and content experience at a consumer brand — ideally a consumer subscription, marketplace, mobile-first, or dating/social platform — with published work and measurable results you can point to.
  • Working fluency in HTML and CSS, sufficient to make on-page SEO edits directly in a CMS. You can open the source, fix the header hierarchy, correct the schema, and publish without waiting on a developer.
  • Strong grasp of traditional SEO fundamentals: on-page optimization, keyword research, internal linking, and technical basics (crawlability, indexation, page speed, structured data).
  • Strong writing and editing skills, with the ability to adapt tone and format across blog, landing page, FAQ, and category content.
  • Working fluency in AEO and GEO. You understand schema markup, structured data, brand-entity strategy, and how AI answer engines choose which sources to cite. You have a point of view on which signals matter and which are noise.
  • Hands-on experience with GA4, Search Console, and at least one paid SEO platform (SEMrush, Ahrefs, or comparable). You read your own analytics.
  • Working knowledge of WordPress sufficient to maintain and update production pages, and light front-end fluency to read and adjust HTML, CSS, and component-level changes when needed.
  • AI fluency. You already use ChatGPT, Claude, Cowork, or similar in your daily workflow to research, draft, structure, and QA content, and to replace work you used to do by hand. If someone has to explain to you why AI matters, this role is not for you.
  • Ready to run on day one. You can audit how Seeking shows up across search and AI surfaces, identify what is broken, and ship a fix in week one.
  • Operator’s discipline. You ship on time, your QA is tight, your naming and metadata are clean, and you document what you did.

Level & Experience

SEO & Content Specialist

  • 2 to 4 years of hands-on experience in SEO, content, or organic growth at a consumer brand or agency serving consumer brands.
  • Practical track record of hand-editing pages, publishing content, and moving pages up the SERP with results you can walk through.
  • Owns execution end-to-end across on-page SEO, content writing, and agency coordination. Contributes to editorial calendar and discovery priorities with the Director.

SEO & Content Strategist

  • 4 to 7+ years of hands-on experience in SEO and content, ideally including time at a consumer subscription business, DTC brand, or category-defining consumer brand.
  • Proven track record leading organic growth programs that combine on-page execution, editorial planning, and AI-search visibility, with measurable business impact.
  • Owns both execution and strategy. Sets the discovery roadmap, drives the editorial calendar, and can defend a prioritization call to the Director and CMO.
  • Comfortable owning or contributing to an editorial calendar across multiple content channels, and directing agency and freelance partners at scope.
  • Mentors and reviews. Comfortable being the go-to reviewer for on-page work, content quality, and discovery strategy as the function scales.
  • Direct experience optimizing for zero-click results, featured snippets, AI Overviews, and answer-engine citations at a consumer brand.

Preferred Qualifications (Both Levels)

  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, journalism, English, or a related field. Equivalent practical experience considered.
  • A portfolio of published SEO or content work with measurable results (traffic lift, ranking gains, or AI-answer citations you can point to).
  • Direct experience partnering with or working inside an outside marketing, SEO, or content agency, including day-to-day vendor management.
  • Experience leading or supporting a CMS migration, particularly off WordPress onto a more automated or AI-native publishing stack.
  • Familiarity with leading or contributing to a structured AEO/GEO program, not just executing within one.

Senior AI Risk Analyst (Remote)

Full time, Remote Colombia, Costa Rica, Mexico

The Senior AI Risk Analyst operates within the Information Security function as a core contributor to the enterprise AI GRC Program, responsible for assessing and managing AI, data, privacy, and security risks across the full lifecycle of AI-enabled capabilities. The role applies structured, standards-based risk and impact assessment methodologies aligned to ISO/IEC 42001, the EU AI Act, and NIST AI RMF including evaluation of risks to the organization, individuals, and fundamental rights.

This position requires the ability to classify AI systems by risk tier, determine regulatory obligations, and translate complex requirements into actionable controls and business decisions, while embedding governance into AI use case intake, design, deployment, and monitoring.

The Senior AI Risk Analyst ensures continuous risk evaluation and audit-defensible outcomes, including preparation for AI conformity assessments, maintenance of traceable documentation, and generation of evidence required to demonstrate compliance to governance forums and regulators.

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in AI-specific risk domains (e.g., bias, explainability, data quality, model behavior) and a governance-first mindset, enabling the delivery of clear, actionable insights that support responsible, secure, and compliant adoption of AI across the enterprise.

As a Senior AI Risk Analyst, you will

  • Conduct AI, security, privacy, and data risk assessments across the AI lifecycle using structured methodologies (identification, analysis, evaluation, scoring, and treatment)
  • Perform AI impact assessments, evaluating potential impacts to individuals, safety, and fundamental rights, and support risk classification of AI systems
  • Identify and assess AI-specific risks (e.g., bias, explainability, data quality, model behavior), including control gaps, residual risk, and treatment options
  • Apply and evaluate controls aligned to internal policy, ISO/IEC 42001, and regulatory requirements, ensuring risks are effectively mitigated
  • Embed governance requirements into AI use case intake, design, deployment, and monitoring through partnership with cross-functional stakeholders
  • Maintain AI system inventory and intake data to support consistent risk assessment and regulatory alignment
  • Produce and maintain traceable, audit-ready documentation linking risks, controls, decisions, and outcomes
  • Support AI conformity and regulatory readiness, including preparation of documentation and evidence for internal and external review
  • Continuously monitor AI systems for changes in risk (e.g., model drift, new data, evolving use), triggering reassessment and control updates
  • Provide clear, actionable risk insights and recommendations to technical teams, business stakeholders, and governance forums

About you

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Risk Management, or related field, or equivalent experience
  • Previous experience conducting structured risk assessments, with demonstrated use of formal methodologies (risk identification, analysis, evaluation, scoring, treatment)
  • Hands-on experience performing AI risk and/or AI impact assessments, including evaluation of organizational, individual, and regulatory risk
  • Proven ability to identify control gaps, evaluate control effectiveness, and define risk treatment and residual risk decisions
  • Working knowledge of AI governance and risk frameworks, including ISO/IEC 42001, NIST AI RMF, and ISO/IEC 27001/27005
  • Familiarity with EU AI Act concepts, including risk classification, high-risk systems, and core regulatory expectations (e.g., transparency, human oversight)
  • Experience in a global, regulated environment, with exposure to privacy, data protection, and cross-border requirements
  • Ability to translate technical and regulatory risk into clear, actionable business insights
  • Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally across Security, Privacy, Legal, Compliance, Technology, and Business teams
  • Experience implementing or supporting AI governance programs and lifecycle-based risk management
  • Experience with AI risk classification, impact assessment, or regulatory alignment related to EU AI Act or similar frameworks
  • Experience producing audit-ready documentation and evidence supporting risk, controls, and governance decisions
  • Familiarity with AI-specific risks, including bias, explainability, data quality, model drift, and system robustness
  • Experience supporting conformity assessment or regulatory readiness activities
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., ISO/IEC 42001, ISO/IEC 27001, CISSP, CISM, CRISC, AIGP)
  • Demonstrated governance-first mindset and ability to operate in evolving regulatory environments

jobs.description:
About Calibrant Energy

Calibrant is a leading provider of on-site energy solutions. Calibrant develops, owns, and operates large-scale solar, battery storage, and microgrids on behalf of our customers—empowering North America's largest power users to achieve their energy goals faster, more economically, and more sustainably.

By combining innovative financing with deep industry expertise, we solve complex energy challenges for large organizations. Our performance-based, no-capex contracts ensure we only get paid when we deliver results—enabling organizations to share in cost savings without any upfront investment.

Position Overview

The Senior Financial Analyst is the forecasting and analytical center of our finance function. Where the accounting team closes the books, this role turns that output into forward-looking decision support: the consolidated cash forecast, the annual budget, project-level economics, and the reporting our lenders, sponsors, and partners rely on.

You will work directly with senior finance leadership and present to the executive team. The scope is real from day one, and it grows for someone who earns it. We are looking for an experienced finance professional who can build the number, defend the number, and say what the business should do about it.

Principal Duties and Responsibilities

Forecasting & Liquidity

The consolidated cash forecast and the core FP&A model — rolling liquidity, funds flow, and debt service across the entity structure.

The weekly cash outlook, and a clear explanation of every material forecast-to-actual variance.

Funding requirements for projects under construction, with the downside and sensitivity cases around them.

Budgeting, Planning & Variance

The annual budget and reforecast cycles across SG&A, headcount, and project capital.

Monthly budget-versus-actual reporting with driver-based commentary — the story, not just the variance column.

Assumption-setting with department leads, and accountability to those assumptions through the year.

Lender, Sponsor & Investor Reporting

Recurring reporting packages for project lenders and equity sponsors.

Covenant calculations and a forward-looking view of headroom, so risk surfaces early rather than at a deadline.

Sponsor, joint-venture, and tax-equity reporting.

Project Economics & Transaction Support

Project-level revenue, margin, cash, and return reporting, reconciled back to the general ledger.

Performance analysis by project, customer, technology, and revenue stream.

Operating results measured against original underwriting, with the drivers of any gap quantified.

Analytical support on financings, refinancings, and asset sales, and on capital allocation decisions.

Systems & Analytical Standards

Moving recurring reporting out of spreadsheets and into the ERP, and helping select and implement a dedicated planning platform.

Documentation of critical models and processes to a hand-off standard.

Automation that removes recurring manual work from the monthly cycle.

What Success Looks Like

Within 90 days, you own the weekly cash outlook and the monthly consolidated forecast end to end.

Within six months, budget-versus-actual reporting and the covenant forecast run on a fixed calendar, with commentary leadership can act on.

Within twelve months, the reporting cycle runs on systems rather than spreadsheets, critical models are documented to a hand-off standard, and you are the person leadership calls before a decision rather than after.

Requirements

Qualifications

Required

  • 3–6 years in FP&A, corporate finance, project finance, transaction services, or public accounting moving into industry.
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Advanced Excel modeling: three-statement and cash flow models, scenario and sensitivity analysis. You can build a model from a blank worksheet, and you can audit someone else's.
  • Working knowledge of US GAAP and a practical understanding of how accounting output drives forecasting.
  • Multi-entity experience, including consolidation and intercompany, with the ability to pull and reconcile your own data from an ERP.

Nice to Have

  • Energy, renewables, infrastructure, or another project-financed business.
  • NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, or a comparable multi-entity ERP.
  • Project-level debt, covenant reporting, tax equity, or partnership waterfalls.
  • Planning tools (Anaplan, Adaptive, Vena) and BI tools (Power BI, Tableau).
  • CPA, CFA, or active progress toward either.

Benefits

We believe in fostering an inclusive environment in which employees feel encouraged to share their unique perspectives, leverage their strengths, and act authentically.

At Calibrant Energy, our priority is to ensure that every team member feels valued and supported. We believe putting wellness first supports a full, holistic, and happier life. We support that by offering benefits that cover you and your family such as: medical, dental, vision insurances, paid time off, paid personal time, paid holidays, paid birthday, paid sick time, company paid short term disability and long term disability, company paid life insurance, 401k with a company match, and more.

jobs.excerpt: Director of Policy and Research The National Institute for Reproductive Health (NIRH) and the National Institute for Reproductive Health Action Fund (NIRH Action Fund), advocacy groups that fight for just and equitable access to reproductive health care, are seeking a full-time Director of Policy and Research to help them in building political power for reproductive freedom.
jobs.description:
Director of Policy and Research

The National Institute for Reproductive Health (NIRH) and the National Institute for Reproductive Health Action Fund (NIRH Action Fund), advocacy groups that fight for just and equitable access to reproductive health care, are seeking a full-time Director of Policy and Research to help them in building political power for reproductive freedom.

This is a benefit eligible, full time, exempt position that will require 35 hours of work, with flexibility, during normal business hours, Monday to Friday, 10 AM to 6 PM. The annual salary for this position is between $115,000 - $125,000 commensurate with experience.

WHO WE ARE

The National Institute for Reproductive Health (NIRH) and the National Institute for Reproductive Health Action Fund (NIRH Action Fund) are advocacy groups that fight for just and equitable access to reproductive health care and build political power for reproductive freedom. For decades, our strategy has been to go on the offensive, at the state and local level, so we have a long track record of passing laws that are safeguarding and advancing access.

In states and cities across the country, we launch campaigns, change policy, and elect candidates who champion our cause, all by working hand-in-hand with reproductive health, rights, and justice organizations; health care providers; and other groups invested in this fight. We partner in communities where change is needed and where we can make a difference. At the national level, we engage in groundbreaking public opinion research, proactive policy initiatives, and innovative advocacy campaigns to help reshape the national conversation about reproductive freedom.

Our approach to advocacy, policy, and politics strives to center the people who are most impacted by barriers to care, historically underserved, and often under-represented — Black women and Black communities, Indigenous and other communities of color, low-income people, and immigrants.

We don’t just push back against restrictions on reproductive autonomy; we fight for a society in which everyone has the freedom and ability to control their reproductive and sexual lives.

THE ROLE

Reporting to, and partnering closely with, the VP of Policy & Research, the Director of Policy and Research will lead and coordinate NIRH's policy work across the organization's three campaign priorities: ensuring access to abortion care through policies that improve affordability; ensuring people have access to culturally congruent and affirming pregnancy care; and protecting and reducing the criminalization of pregnant people and reproductive health care providers by improving data privacy.

This role brings deep policy expertise to campaign architecture, working alongside state and local partners to develop legislation, secure administrative and regulatory changes, and build the policy infrastructure that makes durable wins possible across state and political contexts.

The Policy Director will shape strategy for NIRH's public funding and coverage work, with a particular focus on Medicaid, insurance coverage, and appropriations across multiple states. The role applies an intersectional and reproductive justice lens to all policy development and advocacy efforts.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Lead policy and advocacy strategy to develop legislation, regulations, and other policy solutions that expand coverage and funding for reproductive health care, including pregnancy care and abortion and ensure those solutions are implemented
  • Identify creative, strategic pathways to advance policy and serve as a thought partner and subject-matter expert on emerging policy opportunities
  • Co-develop policy and campaign strategy with state-based partners, serving as a peer strategist and subject-matter expert on public funding and coverage, bringing deep policy knowledge into shared problem-solving and ideation
  • Generate replicable policy frameworks, model legislation, and advocacy resources drawing from Lab cohort work and from active engagement in Medicaid, health equity, budget, and appropriations spaces and coalitions
  • Build NIRH’s profile as a trusted expert in reproductive health policy by contributing substantive expertise in external meetings, convenings, and collaborative spaces
  • Draft and review legislative, regulatory, and advocacy materials, including policy memos, testimony, comments, and partner-facing guidance.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

  • 7 to 12 years of policy and advocacy experience, including at least 3 years of state level advocacy experience
  • Demonstrated success advancing state legislation and/or securing administrative or regulatory policy changes
  • Demonstrated experience working at the intersections of policy issues such as Medicaid and reproductive health, including birth justice
  • Deep expertise in at least one, preferably two, of the following areas:
    • State Medicaid programs and coverage policies related to reproductive health care State appropriations and budget processes across multiple states
    • Administrative advocacy with Medicaid programs, insurance commissioners, and other relevant state regulatory bodies
  • Excellent research, writing, and analytical skills, with the ability to turn complex legal and policy concepts into actionable guidance
  • Strong relationship-building skills and experience working collaboratively with external partners, coalitions, and cross-functional teams
  • Commitment to applying an intersectional and reproductive justice lens to policy recommendations and advocacy
  • Preferred but not required:
    • Experience working at the intersection of policy advocacy and political or electoral strategy, including coordinating policy positions with campaign timelines, candidate engagement, or legislative peaks
    • Law degree
    • Experience working in a state or local administrative agency.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Employer paid medical, dental and vision insurance
  • Generous time off package including vacation days, paid holidays, sick days, personal days and your birthday off
  • 401k employee matching
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Fully remote from anywhere in the US
  • Work from home stipend
  • Subscription to DeleteMe to protect employee's personal information
  • Annual professional development budget available for each employee

TO APPLY

Please submit your resume and answer the application questions to be considered. The priority application deadline is September 11, 2026.

This search is being supported by NRG Consulting Group. Please reach out to or with any questions.

NIRH/NIRHAF IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER.

Innovative Environment

We equip these teams with the necessary skills to devise solutions that are valuable, viable, usable, and feasible. While the product designer ensures usability and engineers ensure feasibility, the product manager is accountable for value and viability. Our vendor credentialing product does not work alone. It depends on a set of

whether a vendor gets verified in two days or in three weeks.

This role drives those connections. The commercial relationship, the technical

Today, when a partner integration behaves unexpectedly, or when a partner changes

upstream. When we need a new capability from a partner, requirements get

assembled in the moment. This role closes that gap. This is a builder’s role in the truest sense.

You’ll be creating processes, documenting systems, and establishing the operational backbone that determines how we scale. If you prefer following playbooks over writing them, this role probably isn’t for you.

somewhere you sat between a product team and third-party API providers.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.What this opportunity involves:
We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT:

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)

Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

Customer Success Manager

We are looking for a proactive and relationship-focused Customer Success Manager to support and strengthen our relationships with existing B2B customers.

This is a customer success and account management role focused on customer retention, satisfaction, and long-term account growth. Rather than closing sales, you'll build trusted relationships, conduct regular customer check-ins, identify new business opportunities, and collaborate with the Sales team to ensure customers receive the best possible experience.

The ideal candidate has experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or Client Services and enjoys building strong client relationships while uncovering opportunities that help customers grow.

Responsibilities

Customer Relationship Management

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for an assigned portfolio of existing customer accounts.

  • Conduct proactive customer check-ins via phone, email, and virtual meetings.
  • Ensure customers remain satisfied with services and address concerns before they become issues.
  • Identify and escalate potential retention risks.

Account Growth Support

  • Engage customers in consultative conversations to understand their business needs and future plans.
  • Identify opportunities for upselling or cross-selling additional products and services.
  • Document qualified opportunities and hand them over to the Sales team for follow-up.
  • Work closely with Sales to ensure a smooth customer experience throughout the expansion process.

Customer Success & Internal Coordination

  • Act as the voice of the customer by sharing feedback with internal teams.
  • Collaborate with Sales, Engineering, Operations, and Support teams to resolve customer issues.
  • Support onboarding follow-ups and maintain ongoing customer engagement.
  • Ensure customers receive timely updates and support throughout their journey.

CRM & Reporting

  • Maintain accurate customer records, account notes, and activity logs in the CRM.
  • Track account health, renewals, and service updates.
  • Provide customer insights and trends to leadership.
  • Ensure all customer interactions are documented accurately.

Required Experience & Skills

Must-Have

  • 2+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Client Services, Relationship Management, or a similar customer-facing role.
  • Experience managing relationships with B2B customers.
  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
  • Comfortable making proactive outbound calls to existing customers.
  • Strong consultative communication and relationship-building skills.
  • Experience using CRM platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar.
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating across multiple teams.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience in telecommunications, wireless, internet services, managed services, or technology industries.
  • Experience supporting geographically distributed customer accounts.
  • Understanding of B2B technology or connectivity solutions.
  • Previous experience working with U.S.-based customers.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Customer Retention Rate
  • Customer Satisfaction
  • Qualified Upsell & Cross-Sell Opportunities Identified
  • CRM Data Accuracy
  • Customer Engagement
  • Account Health

Interview Process

  1. Initial Recruiter Screening
  2. Client Interview
  3. Offer Stage

What happens after you apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. It’s a short, self-recorded video, completed once on your own time, and it’s the final step that completes your application.

Here’s why we do it this way. Instead of repeating yourself on screening call after screening call, you tell your story once and it carries forward. Hiring managers get to see how you actually communicate before you meet, so when you’re a fit, the first conversation isn’t starting from scratch. Fewer interviews, and the ones you do have count for more.

Don’t overthink it. Record it as many times as you like—nobody sees the takes you discard. Just be yourself. Your Intro Video invitation will come from Spark Hire, our trusted video interview platform, so please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for the email.
