Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide. Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit .

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on!

THE JOB

We are currently looking for a Comedy Club Marketing Coordinator. Under the guidance of the Head of Comedy Club Marketing, this person will support marketing campaigns designed to drive ticket sales, audience growth, brand visibility, and fan engagement across Live Nation’s portfolio of comedy clubs.

The Coordinator will provide essential administrative, campaign, and creative support to the Comedy Club Marketing Team. Responsibilities include comic and audience research, coordination and delivery of marketing assets, support for digital advertising and owned CRM channels, invoice processing, grassroots promotions, and post-event reporting.

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

  • Perform a range of administrative, campaign, and marketing support duties for the Comedy Club Marketing Team.

  • Support the development and execution of marketing campaigns that drive ticket sales and event awareness across multiple comedy clubs and markets.

  • Build and schedule owned CRM communications, including email newsletters and SMS campaigns, using approved creative, messaging, audience segments, and promotional offers.

  • Assist with digital advertising campaigns across Meta, TikTok, and other paid media platforms.

  • Request artwork and other creative assets from internal design teams and help manage projects from initial request through delivery.

  • Research comic, audience, and market demographic information to help inform campaign strategy, targeting, and promotional plans.

  • Support organic social media efforts by coordinating approved graphics, videos, show information, and promotional messaging.

  • Assist with the development and maintenance of marketing and content calendars aligned with show announcements, on-sales, presales, holidays, tours, and local market opportunities.

  • Coordinate grassroots marketing campaigns, including ordering flyers and posters, shipping promotional materials, and supporting local community outreach.

  • Support presale, group sales, partner, festival, and community-based promotional initiatives.

  • Assist with in-venue marketing updates, including posters, signage, digital screens, and other promotional materials.

  • Ensure all necessary show and campaign information is accurately entered into Live Nation’s proprietary marketing tools and tracking systems.

  • Code and process incoming advertising and marketing invoices, maintain accurate records, and assist with resolving payment questions.

  • Gather campaign results and prepare event marketing recap reports, including key activities, performance metrics, learnings, and supporting materials.

  • Provide day-of-show marketing and event coverage as necessary.

  • Work collaboratively with Marketing, Booking, Operations, and other internal teams to support show promotions and new programming initiatives.

  • Maintain organized campaign files, trackers, timelines, and documentation across a high volume of events.

  • Ability to work extended hours, including evenings and weekends, as dictated by show dates, campaign deadlines, and business needs.

  • Assist with additional duties and special projects as assigned.

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred, but not required

  • Extensive live entertainment knowledge: event planning, comedy, concert or sports marketing experience preferred

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

  • Ability to work in a fast paced, deadline driven environment while juggling multiple tasks.

  • 1-3 years of prior experience in event assisting/planning or marketing experience within an entertainment, sports or public assembly facility setting

  • Ability to troubleshoot and problem solve independently

  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written

  • Ability to work in a very busy, high-pressure, team setting

  • Strong collaboration skills - can work well with navigating various stakeholders and teams

BENEFITS & PERKS

Our motto is ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ through 6 pillars of benefits:

HEALTH: Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA)

YOURSELF: Free concert tickets, generous paid time off including paid holidays, sick time, and personal days

WEALTH: 401(k) program with company match, stock reimbursement program

FAMILY: New parent programs including caregiver leave, plus fertility, adoption, foster, or surrogacy support

CAREER: Career and skill development programs with School of Live, tuition reimbursement, and student loan repayment

OTHERS: Volunteer time off, crowdfunding match

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

We aspire to build teams that reflect and support the fans and artists we serve. Every day we aim to promote environments where everyone can be themselves, contribute fully, and thrive within our company and at our events. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with.

Live Nation strongly supports equal employment opportunity for all applicants regardless of age (40 and over), ancestry, color, religious creed (including religious dress and grooming practices), family and medical care leave or the denial of family and medical care leave, mental or physical disability (including HIV and AIDS), marital status, domestic partner status, medical condition (including cancer and genetic characteristics), genetic information, military and veteran status, political affiliation, national origin (including language use restrictions), citizenship, race, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding and medical conditions related to pregnancy, childbirth or breastfeeding), gender, gender identity, and gender expression, sexual orientation, intersectionality, or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state or local law, rule, ordinance or regulation.

We also afford equal employment opportunities to qualified individuals with a disability. For this reason, Live Nation will make reasonable accommodations for the known physical or mental limitations of an otherwise qualified individual with a disability who is an applicant consistent with its legal obligations to do so, including reasonable accommodations related to pregnancy in accordance with applicable local, state and / or federal law. As part of its commitment to make reasonable accommodations, Live Nation also wishes to participate in a timely, good faith, interactive process with a disabled applicant to determine effective reasonable accommodations, if any, which can be made in response to a request for accommodations. Applicants are invited to identify reasonable accommodations that can be made to assist them to perform the essential functions of the position they seek. Any applicant who requires an accommodation in order to perform the essential functions of the job should contact a Human Resources Representative to request the opportunity to participate in a timely interactive process. Live Nation will also provide reasonable religious accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

HIRING PRACTICES
The preceding job description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job.

Live Nation recruitment policies are designed to place the most highly qualified persons available in a timely and efficient manner. Live Nation may pursue all avenues available, including promotion from within, employee referrals, outside advertising, employment agencies, internet recruiting, job fairs, college recruiting and search firms. Live Nation may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support application screening and assessment. All hiring decisions are made with human review.

Live Nation Entertainment will never request payment or equipment purchases as part of the hiring process. Recruiters will only contact candidates from official Live Nation or affiliated brand email domains.

jobs.description:
Description

The Senior Statistical Programmer will lead single and/or multiple clinical trials and be responsible for the development, maintenance, and validation of annotated Case Report Forms (aCRFs) as well as of specifications and statistical programming of Standard Data Tabulation Model (SDTM) datasets, Analysis Data Model (ADaM) datasets (or derived datasets, as applicable), Tables, Listings, and Figures (TLFs), and submission packages required for various purposes including, but not limited to, Data Monitoring Committee (DMC) data review meetings, Interim Analyses (IAs), and Clinical Study Reports (CSR). The Senior Statistical Programmer will also review and provide input into Statistical Analysis Plans (SAPs), TLF Shells, and various Data Management (DM) documents (e.g., electronic Case Report Forms [eCRFs], edit checks, etc.), support DM with data cleaning activities, use global SAS macros and participate to internal initiatives to increase efficiency of the statistical programming of SDTMs, ADaMs, derived datasets, and TFLs, and use Pinnacle 21 to validate SDTMs, ADaMs, and define.XMLs.

The Senior Statistical Programmer will work collaboratively within Biostatistical study teams and across departments to produce deliverables of the highest quality possible, within agreed timelines and budget, and in conformance with applicable International Council for Harmonization (ICH) guidelines, Pharmaceutical Industry standards and guidelines, Regulatory Authority requirements and guidelines, and Innovaderm’ standard operating procedures (SOPs) and processes.

More specifically, the Senior Statistical Programmer must:

  • Adhere and promote company organizational values and related expected behaviors, follow company SOPs and processes for all deliverables, and ensure all trainings assigned to oneself are completed on time.
  • Act as a Lead Statistical Programmer on multiple single studies.
  • Review the statistical programming scope of work and budget at initiation of clinical trials and identify tasks that are out of scope.
  • Review and provide input into various DM documents (e.g., eCRF, edit checks, etc.), SAPs, and TLF Shells.
  • Support DM with data cleaning activities by programming, reporting, reviewing, and closing statistical data issues in collaboration with other Statistical Programmers and Lead Biostatistician.
  • Develop/maintain/validate (as applicable) aCRFs according to protocol, eCRF, and Innovaderm and/or Sponsor' standards and interpretation of Clinical Data Interchange Standards Consortium (CDISC) SDTM Implementation Guideline (IG) and Controlled Terminology (CT).
  • Develop/maintain/validate (as applicable) specifications and Primary or QC statistical programming (as applicable) of SDTMs, ADaMs (or derived datasets, as applicable), and TLFs based on protocol, aCRF, SAP, TLF Shells, Innovaderm and/or Sponsor's standards and interpretation of CDISC SDTM IG, ADaM IG, and CT and address any finding appropriately in collaboration with Statistical Programmer counterpart and/or Lead Biostatistician (as applicable).
  • Develop/maintain/validate (as applicable) of SDTM define.XML/.PDF, clinical SDTM Reviewer’ Guide (cSDRG), ADaMs define.XML/.PDF, and ADaM Reviewer’ Guide (ADRG) based on SDTM specifications, ADaM specifications, and Innovaderm and/or Sponsor' standards and interpretation of CDISC Define guidelines and address any finding appropriately in collaboration with Statistical Programmer counterpart and/or Lead Biostatistician (as applicable).
  • Validate SDTMs, ADaMs, and define.XMLs using Pinnacle 21 and address any finding appropriately in collaboration with Statistical Programmer counterpart and/or Lead Biostatistician (as applicable).
  • Use global SAS macros to increase efficiency of the statistical programming of SDTMs, ADaMs, derived datasets, and TFLs.
  • Act as Unblinded Primary or QC Statistical Programmer for randomization plans and lists, IDMCs, and IAs.
  • Contribute to the identification of future internal initiatives to increase efficiency/quality of Statistical Programming activities/deliverables.
  • Participate to internal initiatives to increase efficiency/quality of Statistical Programming activities/deliverables, including but not limited to development/ improvement/validation of standard macros, templates, and programming standards and processes.
  • Keep oneself abreast with latest Industry and CDISC standards as well as ICH and Regulatory Authority guidance and requirements.

May also:

  • Mentor more junior Statistical Programmers.
  • Employee may be assigned to other responsibilities that do not pertain to their former description, if they have the required experience, are qualified and/or have received adequate training.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Computing Sciences or a related field; master’s degree an asset.
  • At least 5 years of clinical research experience in biotechnology, pharmaceutical or Contract Research Organization (CRO) industry, including 4 years of Statistical Programming and 1 year acting as a Lead Statistical Programmer.
  • Excellent exposure to clinical trial data, SAP, TLF Shells, and specifications.
  • Excellent working knowledge of SAS; SAS certification an asset.
  • Knowledge of XML programming an asset.
  • Excellent working knowledge of CDISC standards and guideline; CDISC certification an asset.
  • Excellent knowledge of drug development process, ICH guideline (including but not limited to, ICH E6, E9, and E9(R1)), relevant Health Canada (HC) and Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations, guidelines, and electronic data submission requirements, and Pharmaceutical Industry GPP.
  • Very organized and detail-oriented, with effective project planning and time management skills.
  • Ability to work in high-speed environment with proven agility to juggle and prioritize multiple competitive demands.
  • Must be able to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills in English; French an asset.

Our company

At Indero, formely Innovaderm, you will work with brilliant and driven colleagues. Our values are collaboration, innovation, reliability and responsiveness. We offer a stimulating work environment and attractive advancement opportunities.

As a Senior Statistical Programmer, you will be eligible for the following perks:

  • Permanent full-time position
  • Flexible schedule
  • Home-based position
  • Ongoing learning and development

Work location

The successful candidate for this position is given to work remotely anywhere in Romania

About Indero, formely Innovaderm

Indero, formely Innovaderm is a contract research organization (CRO) specialized in dermatology. Since its beginnings in 2000, our organization has benefited from a solid reputation for the quality of its research and services exceeding the expectations of its clients. Based in Montreal, Indero, formely Innovaderm continues to grow and expand in North America and Europe.

Indero, formely Innovaderm is committed to providing equitable treatment and equal opportunity to all individuals. As such, Indero, formely Innovaderm will provide accommodations throughout the recruitment and selection process to applicants with disabilities, upon request.

About the role

What we're looking for

About Neo4j:

Neo4j is the graph intelligence platform that transforms data into knowledge to power the next generation of intelligent applications and AI systems. It includes enterprise-ready knowledge graphs for accurate, explainable, and governed AI; the most comprehensive, trusted, and easy-to-deploy graph capabilities across any environment and data source; and an unmatched ecosystem trusted by 84 of the Fortune 100 and supported by the world’s largest graph community. Intelligence that works. Results that matter.

Built to work everywhere and integrate with everything across every cloud for dynamic, personalized, and autonomous AI systems. We deliver quicker results, contextual knowledge, and solutions that impact customers and employees across the business.

Our Vision:

At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data.

As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive.

About the job

You will play a critical role in supporting our enterprise customers early in their journey to ensure the absolute success of their architectural foundations. As a key member of the Professional Services team, you will bridge the gap between a signed contract and a production-ready ecosystem. You will serve as the trusted technical advisor, leading new customers through critical infrastructure milestones—including cloud provisioning, security hardening, networking, data modelling, and application integration.

Sitting at the heart of our customer-first culture, you will shape tailored onboarding blueprints, orchestrate complex delivery workstreams, and guarantee a predictable, accelerated time‑to‑value. For our fully managed AuraDB cloud customers, you will leverage automation to optimise data modelling, enterprise connectivity, and application health. For self‑managed environments, you will apply rigorous Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and platform engineering practices to deliver secure, resilient graph clusters across hybrid and multi-cloud architectures.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience in a highly technical, customer-facing role (e.g., Onboarding Engineering, Customer Success Engineering, DevOps/Platform Engineering, or Technical Consulting).
  • Hands-on experience with production workloads in at least one major cloud provider ecosystem (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud).
  • Deep technical proficiency in core networking infrastructure, including VPC/VNet architectures, routing protocols, peering, and PrivateLink/Private Endpoints.
  • Proven track record implementing Enterprise Identity and Access Management (IAM), including SSO (OIDC/SAML) and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) design.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Strong proficiency in Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) utilising Terraform, alongside configuration management tools like Ansible.
  • Experience with Linux administration, containerisation, and orchestration platforms (Docker, Kubernetes, or managed container environments).
  • Hands-on experience with graph databases (ideally Neo4j) and proficiency in database querying and performance tuning (e.g., Cypher query optimisation).
  • Familiarity with modern observability stacks (Grafana/Prometheus, Datadog, CloudWatch, Splunk) and enterprise data movement frameworks (ETL/CDC platforms).
  • Exposure to cloud compliance frameworks (SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA) and data residency deployment patterns.

Responsibilities

  • Lead complex technical discovery sessions with enterprise customers to align on success criteria, KPIs, milestones, and mitigation strategies for project risks.
  • Guide the instantiation of Neo4j AuraDB environments or self-managed clusters across AWS, Azure, and GCP, establishing secure network architectures utilizing private endpoints and IP allow lists.
  • Implement baseline system hardening, TLS/SSL termination, encryption-at-rest protocols, and enforce least-privileged access through enterprise SSO and RBAC configurations.
  • Architect robust data ingestion pipelines (bulk imports, stream processing, Change Data Capture) and advise development teams on Neo4j driver optimization, connection pooling, and retry logic.
  • Assist customers in configuring enterprise observability tools for logs and metrics, while delivering best-practice workshops on Cypher query performance and backup/restore planning.
  • Produce high-quality technical deliverables—including architecture diagrams, Architectural Decision Records (ADRs), and a next-step backlog—to seamlessly transition customers to Professional Services and Cloud Operations teams.
  • Synthesise field insights and lessons learned to continuously iterate and optimise Neo4j’s global technical onboarding methodology and frameworks.

Neo4j is, without question, the most popular graph intelligence platform in the world. We have customers in every industry globally, and our products are a proven product/market fit. Joining our team is an opportunity to shape the future of data and analytics. Below are just a few exciting facts about Neo4j.

  • Neo4j is one of the fastest-scaling technology companies in this industry. It recently surpassed $200M in annual recurring revenue (ARR), doubling its ARR over the past three years.

Backed by world-class investors like Eurazeo, GV (formerly Google Ventures), and Inovia Capital, Neo4j has raised over $600M in funding and is currently valued at over $2Bn. This puts Neo4j among the most well-funded database companies in history.

  • Co-founder and CEO Emil Eifrem has built an amazing culture that prides itself on relationships, inclusiveness, innovation, and customer success.
  • Countless industry awards. Massive enterprises and individual developers/data scientists love Neo4j. A strong sense of community and ecosystem is built around the platform.
  • A recent Forrester Total Economic Impact™ Study cited Neo4j as delivering 417% ROI to customers.

  • Strong understanding of networking concepts and their security implications.
  • In-depth knowledge of identity and access management (IAM).
  • Security certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CompTIA Security+) preferred.
  • Solid program management skills: planning, execution, and risk management across multiple concurrent workstreams.
  • A track record of representing product externally - with customers, analysts, or at industry events, and translating deep technical security topics for non-technical audiences.
  • Experience guiding or informally mentoring other PMs, even without a formal reporting relationship.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, and the judgment to know when to escalate versus when to just make the call.
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, collaborative environment where priorities shift and you're expected to bring order to it, not just follow along.

jobs.description:
Head of Client Operations (Cold Email, Client Success & Campaign Performance) – Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Head of Client Operations to own everything that happens after a client signs — from campaign performance and delivery to client satisfaction and retention.

This is a high-ownership, hands-on leadership role. You’ll manage 20–30 active client relationships, troubleshoot and optimize cold email campaigns, improve delivery systems, and work directly with the founder, outreach team, and developers.

This is not a traditional account management role. You’ll be accountable for client outcomes, campaign performance, retention, and operational execution.

If you understand cold email and lead generation deeply, thrive in fast-moving startup environments, and can take ownership without waiting for direction, this role is for you.

What You’ll Own

Client Success & Retention

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for 20–30 active clients.
  • Lead client check-ins, performance discussions, and ongoing communication.
  • Manage expectations and resolve client concerns proactively.
  • Identify account risks before they become retention issues.
  • Own client satisfaction, retention, and long-term account health.
  • Handle escalations confidently and professionally.

Cold Email Campaign Performance

  • Monitor campaign performance and identify underperforming accounts.
  • Diagnose and resolve issues involving:
    • Deliverability
    • Inbox placement
    • List quality
    • Messaging and offers
    • Reply and conversion rates
  • QA campaigns before launch.
  • Continuously optimize campaigns based on performance data.
  • Ensure campaigns deliver measurable outcomes for clients.

Copywriting & Campaign Optimization

  • Personally write, review, and improve cold email copy.
  • Optimize:
    • Subject lines
    • Opening hooks
    • Offers
    • Calls-to-action
    • Follow-up sequences
  • Test messaging approaches and use performance data to guide iterations.
  • Balance personalization, deliverability, and conversion performance.

Processes, Systems & Documentation

  • Build and improve scalable client delivery systems.
  • Create:
    • SOPs
    • Playbooks
    • Campaign workflows
    • QA processes
    • Escalation procedures
  • Track SLAs, client health metrics, and delivery standards.
  • Identify operational bottlenecks and implement practical improvements.
  • Build systems that allow client operations to scale without sacrificing quality.

Technical & Cross-Functional Execution

  • Work closely with developers to troubleshoot infrastructure and technical issues.
  • Collaborate with outreach teams on campaign execution and optimization.
  • Understand APIs, automations, integrations, and data workflows well enough to diagnose operational problems.
  • Use AI tools to improve:
    • Campaign analysis
    • Copywriting
    • Research
    • Operational efficiency
    • Troubleshooting
  • Report directly to the founder on client health, risks, performance, and priorities.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Experience leading client operations, account management, client success, or delivery in a startup or fast-moving environment.
  • Strong experience with cold email, outbound lead generation, or performance-driven outreach campaigns.
  • Hands-on expertise in:
    • Cold email strategy
    • Deliverability and inbox placement
    • Cold email copywriting
    • Campaign optimization
    • Lead generation
  • Ability to personally write and improve outbound campaign copy.
  • Experience managing multiple client accounts simultaneously.
  • Strong understanding of APIs, automations, integrations, and data workflows.
  • Experience using AI tools for day-to-day operations, analysis, and optimization.
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication.
  • Comfortable working remotely across U.S. client time zones.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working directly with founders.
  • Background in high-growth or early-stage startups.
  • Experience managing 20+ client accounts simultaneously.
  • Familiarity with cold email infrastructure and outreach platforms.
  • Experience building operational SOPs and scalable client delivery systems.
  • Exposure to technical outbound infrastructure, automation, or RevOps.

Tools & Technology

You should be comfortable working with:

  • Cold email and outreach platforms
  • CRM and campaign management systems
  • AI tools for analysis, content, and optimization
  • Automation platforms
  • APIs and integrations
  • Google Workspace
  • Slack and remote collaboration tools

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • You take ownership of outcomes rather than simply completing tasks.
  • You can confidently manage clients while also working hands-on inside campaigns.
  • You know how to diagnose why an outbound campaign isn’t performing.
  • You can write strong cold email copy yourself.
  • You’re comfortable solving problems without perfect information.
  • You move quickly while maintaining delivery quality.
  • You can balance client relationships, campaign performance, and operational systems simultaneously.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You may:

  • Review campaign performance and client account health.
  • Diagnose deliverability or messaging problems.
  • Rewrite and optimize cold email campaigns.
  • Meet with clients to discuss results and next steps.
  • Identify accounts at risk of churn and develop recovery plans.
  • Coordinate with outreach teams on execution.
  • Work with developers on infrastructure or automation issues.
  • Improve SOPs, workflows, and delivery systems.
  • Update the founder on client performance, risks, and priorities.

In short: you own what happens after the sale — ensuring clients receive strong campaigns, measurable results, responsive communication, and a consistently high-quality experience.

Key Metrics for Success

  • High client retention and reduced churn.
  • Strong campaign deliverability and performance.
  • Client satisfaction and account health.
  • Consistent delivery against SLAs.
  • Fast resolution of campaign and client issues.
  • Improved campaign reply and conversion performance.
  • Scalable and efficient client delivery processes.

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Full ownership of client operations and delivery.
  • Direct impact on retention, revenue, and campaign performance.
  • Work closely with the founder.
  • Opportunity to build systems and processes from the ground up.
  • High-autonomy remote environment.
  • Strong growth potential into broader Operations, Client Success, or executive operations leadership.

Interview Process

  • Initial Screening
  • Founder Interview
  • Final Discussion
  • Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video completes your application and can be recorded whenever it’s convenient.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. You can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it — only your final submission will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation.

Apply Now

If you can own client outcomes, optimize cold email campaigns hands-on, prevent churn, and build scalable delivery systems, we’d love to hear from you.

Identify opportunities where AI can enhance developer productivity, code quality, and team velocity.

Requirements

  • Academic background oriented toward computer science, engineering, or software development disciplines.
  • Development using Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Kafka and AWS.
  • Experience in Python is a plus.
  • Experience with asynchronous programming.
  • Track record of success in hands-on backend engineering positions.
  • Experience working with domains of medium to high complexity.
  • A solid understanding of how web and mobile applications work including security, session management, and best development practices.
  • Knowledge of relational database systems and Object Oriented Programming.
  • Knowledge of Domain-Driven Design (DDD); familiarity with microservice architecture is a plus.
  • Experience conducting code reviews, driving knowledge sharing, and promoting collaborative development practices.
  • Ability to work and thrive in a fast-paced environment, learn rapidly and master diverse web technologies and techniques.
  • Proven ability to design complex distributed applications built for high performance and throughput while being scalable and reliable.
  • Practical experience applying AI frameworks in development projects.
  • Demonstrated experience profiling and performance tuning Java applications, and using monitoring tools for production application monitoring.

Soft Skills

  • Strategic thinking and problem-solving skills, with a proactive approach to identifying and addressing technical and process gaps.

Industry-Specific Knowledge

Experience designing secure, auditable, and scalable APIs for internal and external consumers is also highly desirable. About the Role

At Pavago, we’re hiring a Bilingual Patient Concierge (English/Spanish) for one of our U.S.-based healthcare clients to provide compassionate, professional, and timely support throughout the patient journey.

This is a highly patient-facing role where you’ll serve as one of the first points of contact for new and existing patients. You’ll handle inquiries, schedule consultations and appointments, coordinate follow-ups, maintain accurate patient records, and ensure every interaction feels warm, organized, and supportive.

We’re looking for someone who genuinely enjoys helping people and can build trust quickly over the phone. You should be fluent in both English and Spanish, with clear and easily understandable spoken English.

If you combine empathy with strong organization, attention to detail, and a professional phone presence, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Patient Support & Communication

  • Provide exceptional patient support through phone, SMS, and email.
  • Respond to new patient inquiries and guide patients through consultation and scheduling processes.
  • Communicate confidently and compassionately in both English and Spanish.

Quality, Coaching & Collaboration

  • Collaborate with supervisors and team members to resolve issues.
  • Identify opportunities to improve service quality and internal processes.
  • Maintain consistent professionalism, reliability, and responsiveness.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You are fluent in English and Spanish.
  • Your spoken English is clear and easily understandable.
  • You have a warm, confident, and professional phone presence.
  • You naturally communicate with empathy and patience.
  • You can build trust quickly with patients.
  • You remain composed when handling sensitive or concerned callers.

  • You’re coachable and actively apply feedback.

  • Fluent English and Spanish, both spoken and written.

    • Customer service
    • Patient support
    • Call center operations
    • Medical reception
    • Appointment scheduling
    • Other phone-based customer-facing roles
  • Excellent verbal communication and active listening skills.
  • Strong emotional intelligence and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to handle sensitive conversations professionally.
  • Experience accurately documenting customer or patient interactions.

  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

Preferred Experience

    • CRM platforms
    • Scheduling systems
    • Electronic Medical Records (EMRs)

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day will revolve around helping patients receive a smooth, supportive experience. You may:

  • Answer inbound patient calls and inquiries.
  • Communicate with patients in English and Spanish.
  • Help new patients understand the consultation and scheduling process.
  • Schedule and confirm appointments.
  • Collect and verify patient intake information.
  • Respond to SMS and email inquiries.
  • Follow up with patients who need additional assistance.
  • Update patient notes and documentation.
  • Coordinate with clinics, providers, supervisors, and team members.
  • Participate in coaching or QA sessions.

Apply Now

Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Your Role:

Join Alpaca's global Financial Crimes team and help safeguard the integrity of our customers and the financial markets. In this role, you will support Alpaca Securities' BSA/AML, sanctions, anti-fraud, and securities surveillance programs. You will investigate potentially suspicious activity, prepare SAR recommendations and narratives, and help strengthen scalable, risk-based compliance controls.

This position reports to the AML Manager for Securities & Crypto or the AMLCO's designee. Because the role supports U.S. based operations, the individual must be able to maintain meaningful working-hour overlap with U.S. Eastern Time.

Things You Get To Do:

  • Collaborate with globally-distributed teams to implement and strengthen the firm’s Financial Crimes program and identify risks across CIP/KYC, AML, Anti-Fraud, and Fraud Monitoring initiatives.
  • Investigate potentially suspicious activity through transaction monitoring alerts, escalations, and referrals.
  • Ensure that transaction monitoring alerts, regulatory submissions, and case investigations are completed/submitted within the established deadlines and SLAs.
  • Screen individuals, entities, and transactions to assess potential matches against OFAC, global sanctions, PEP, enforcement, and adverse media watchlists.
  • Review and respond to time-sensitive escalations, FinCEN 314(a) and 314(b) requests, law enforcement queries, and other regulatory inquiries.
  • Support ongoing enhancements to transaction monitoring rules, policies, procedures, controls, and risk frameworks.
  • Maintain audit trails with thorough, defensible documentation of investigations, alert dispositions, and compliance decisions.
  • Proactively identify and escalate critical risks, emerging trends, and compliance gaps to management.
  • Prepare clear, accurate, and timely SAR recommendations and narratives for management review, and support the filing of approved SARs with FinCEN.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders and assist during risk assessments, remediation efforts, external audits, examinations, and regulatory engagements.
  • Maintain strong knowledge of regulatory developments, financial crime typologies and red flags, trading behaviors, and regulatory expectations applicable to Alpaca’s business.
  • Conduct comprehensive CIP/KYC, CDD, and EDD reviews to identify, manage, and mitigate customer and firm-wide risk.
  • Evaluate source of funds, source of wealth, occupation, expected activity, and customer purpose.
  • Review and disposition assigned AML, sanctions, and securities-surveillance alerts from beginning to end.
  • Assist with due diligence and ongoing monitoring of introducing brokers, omnibus partners, correspondents, and other intermediaries.

Who You Are (Must-Haves):

  • Excited about Alpaca’s mission and what we’re building to open financial services to everyone on the plant.
  • 3-5 years of experience in Financial Crime/AML investigations (AML Alert Investigation related to retail, institutional, foreign financial firms)
  • Strong understanding of U.S. regulatory requirements (e.g., BSA/AML, USA PATRIOT Act, SEC/FINRA regulations).
  • Familiarity with trading activity and a variety of financial crime typologies, including spoofing, layering, wash trading, front-running, insider trading, fraud(deposit/withdrawals,account takeover/transfers) and manipulative order behavior.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify and escalate unusual activity and document investigations in a clear, concise, and audit-ready manner.
  • Strong investigative writing skills, including the ability to prepare clear, concise, and audit-ready case narratives and SAR recommendations.
  • Strong analytical skills, sound judgment, attention to detail, and ability to prioritize multiple tasks and deadlines effectively.
  • Experience using transaction-monitoring, sanctions-screening, case-management, fraud-monitoring, or securities-surveillance systems.
  • Ability to work independently and adapt to a rapidly changing business and regulatory environment.
  • Experience conducting open-source intelligence research and evaluating public records, adverse media, corporate information, and other investigative sources.
  • Working knowledge of domestic and international payment systems.
  • Ability and willingness to work a schedule that provides meaningful overlap with U.S. Eastern Time.

Who You Might Be (Nice-to-Haves):

  • Knowledge of FinTech Broker Dealer Space and able to support a fast paced environment.
  • Experience with U.S. Registered Broker/Dealer - Correspondent Clearing Firms.
  • Familiarity with Transaction alerting platforms (e.g. riskCanvas/Genpact).
  • Previous experience working in a remote or global team environment.
  • Ability to identify automation opportunities and leverage AI tools to enhance efficiency.
  • Experience investigating U.S. ACH, wire, brokerage transfer, ACATS, digital-asset, or cross-border payment activity.
  • CAMS, CFCS, CFE, or another relevant AML, fraud, or financial crime certification preferred.

  • New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500

jobs.description:
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

Job Details

Position Summary

The Director, Research Platform Strategy will play a critical role in shaping the future of Cencora’s Management Services Organization (MSO) Platform by helping formulate and execute the strategic plan for a cross-MSO research capability. Research is a key growth and revenue driver within the MSO Platform’s strategic growth plan, and this role will be central to determining which research capabilities should be centralized at the platform level (shared services) versus retained within individual MSOs (e.g., RCA, OneOncology) to maximize scale, efficiency, and growth.

Reporting to the SVP and Head of Clinical Trial Services, this role will assess current research capabilities across MSOs, design a future-state operating model, and partner closely with MSO leadership, Affinity Groups, and the Strategic Operating Group (SOG) to build and stand up a scalable, high-performing research platform.

The ideal candidate combines strong strategic and analytical capabilities with the ability to assess current-state capabilities, design future-state operating models, and drive execution across a complex, matrixed organization.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Planning & Platform Design

  • Support the Head of Clinical Trial Services in formulating a comprehensive strategy for a cross-MSO research platform, aligned to the MSO Platform’s overall growth objectives.

  • Conduct current-state assessments of existing research capabilities across MSOs (e.g., RCA, OneOncology), identifying strengths, gaps, and redundancies.

  • Develop a future-state operating model that defines which research capabilities should reside at the platform level (shared services) versus the individual MSO level, balancing standardization with MSO-specific needs.

  • Build the business case (investment, ROI, revenue impact) for platform-level research infrastructure, informed by the MSO Platform’s strategic growth plan.

Capability Assessment & Operating Model Design

  • Map existing research functions, teams, technology, and processes across MSOs to identify overlaps, gaps, and opportunities for standardization.

  • Define decision criteria and frameworks for evaluating “platform vs. MSO” placement of research capabilities (e.g., regulatory/compliance infrastructure, trial recruitment, data & analytics, contracting).

  • Partner with the Data & AI and IT Infrastructure Affinity Groups to evaluate technology and analytics needs to support a scalable research platform.

  • Translate the operating model into a phased implementation roadmap with clearly scoped initiatives, milestones, owners, and timelines.

Execution & Program Management

  • Lead execution of platform strategy initiatives, coordinating across cross-functional teams and MSO stakeholders to ensure milestones are met.

  • Stand up pilot programs to test proposed shared-services models before scaling platform-wide.

  • Anticipate and resolve interdependencies across MSOs, Affinity Groups, and the SOG to keep initiatives on track.

  • Establish governance mechanisms (e.g., steering committees, review cadences) to sustain the research platform’s evolution over time.

Cross-MSO Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

  • Build strong working relationships with MSO leadership (including RCA and OneOncology) to understand unique research needs and secure buy-in for the platform strategy.

  • Serve as a key liaison between the Head of Clinical Trial Services and MSO/Affinity Group stakeholders, ensuring alignment on approach, scope, and sequencing.

  • Communicate strategy, progress, and recommendations clearly to senior leadership, including trade-offs and risks.

Performance Tracking & Continuous Improvement

  • Define success metrics for the research platform strategy, including revenue growth, trial volume, and efficiency gains from shared services.

  • Monitor progress against the platform roadmap and refine the strategy based on performance data and MSO feedback.

  • Capture lessons learned and build reusable frameworks/playbooks to support future MSOs joining the research platform.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, healthcare management, business administration, or a related field; advanced degree (e.g., MBA, MPH) preferred.

  • 8+ years of experience in clinical research, healthcare strategy, management consulting, or a related field, including experience designing or scaling operating models across multiple business units.

  • Experience in a private-equity-backed, multi-site, or platform/roll-up healthcare environment strongly preferred.

  • Proven ability to translate strategy into actionable, milestone-driven execution plans with limited oversight.

Skills and Competencies

  • Strategic & Systems Thinking: Ability to evaluate complex, cross-organizational problems and design scalable operating models that balance centralization with local flexibility.

  • Analytical Rigor: Strong capability to assess current-state capabilities, build business cases, and use data to inform platform design decisions.

  • Stakeholder Influence: Ability to build alignment among peers, MSO leaders, and cross-functional partners without direct authority.

  • Program Management: Skilled at translating strategy into structured plans with clear milestones, owners, and accountability mechanisms.

  • Communication: Able to synthesize complex information into clear, actionable recommendations for senior leadership.

  • Healthcare/Clinical Research Acumen: Working knowledge of clinical trial operations, regulatory considerations, and specialty/value-based care models.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Completion and adoption of the cross-MSO research platform strategy and operating model.

  • Growth in research-related revenue contribution to the MSO Platform’s strategic growth plan.

  • Number/percentage of research capabilities successfully transitioned to platform-level shared services.

  • Timeliness and quality of execution against the platform roadmap.

  • Stakeholder satisfaction and alignment across MSOs (RCA, OneOncology, and future MSOs).

What Cencora offers

We provide compensation, benefits, and resources that enable a highly inclusive culture and support our team members’ ability to live with purpose every day. In addition to traditional offerings like medical, dental, and vision care, we also provide a comprehensive suite of benefits that focus on the physical, emotional, financial, and social aspects of wellness. jobs.description:
Natera is seeking a Lead Bioinformatics Engineer to own pipeline and infrastructure engineering for a research informatics team working on cell-free DNA (cfDNA) screening in Women's and Organ Health. This is an individual contributor role.

You will own our WDL workflows, the transition toward Nextflow, the AWS infrastructure the team runs on, and the tooling around them. You will inherit a working system from the person who built it, and with them still on the team to teach you.

Our workflows leave clear wins available in cost and runtime for whoever takes them on. Getting scientists to the point where they process their own samples end to end, without an engineer in the loop, is a major thrust of this role.

Primary Responsibilities:

Workflow and Pipeline Engineering: Maintain and improve our WDL workflows on AWS Batch and AWS HealthOmics. Own how new Nextflow workflows and existing WDL workflows run on one set of tooling and infrastructure. Make pipelines easier for scientists to run correctly without engineering support.

Infrastructure and Operability: Own the team's AWS infrastructure, managed as code in Terraform. Improve reliability, reproducibility, and observability across our compute environments. Build testing, monitoring, and alerting that surface failures before a scientist finds them.

Tooling and Developer Productivity: Build and harden internal tooling that reduces manual work for the team, including support for triage of production issues. Make new capabilities easier to test, document, and hand off.

Ways of Working: Use coding agents as a routine part of engineering here, for implementation, code review, investigation, and operational triage. You own what you ship regardless of what produced it, which means reviewing and testing agent-written code to the same standard as your own, and helping the team decide which of these tools are worth adopting.

Collaboration and Handoff: Partner with the team's science leads and data scientists on getting new methods into production pipelines and providing first line review of their changes, and with the production organization on handoff readiness for capabilities moving out of research.

What success looks like after a year:

  • You own the team's pipelines and infrastructure without supervision.
  • Transition to new workflows on the same tooling and infrastructure from our existing workflows.
  • Scientists run and debug their own pipeline work without coming to you first.
  • Operational interruptions to the team's scientific work are down.
  • Agent-assisted work is a normal part of how you work.

Qualifications:

  • Degree in Bioinformatics, Computer Science, Computational Biology, or a related field. A degree is not a requirement: equivalent depth built through work counts fully.
  • 4+ years of software or pipeline engineering experience, preferably in a life sciences, sequencing, or production-adjacent setting. We count relevant experience from the point your work became substantially independent, however you got there.
  • Demonstrated ownership of a system end to end. We mean operating it in production, not only building the first version.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

What we are screening for

  • Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals, including testing and debugging practice.
  • Experience with at least one workflow system: Snakemake, CWL, WDL, Nextflow, or similar.
  • Real cloud experience, ideally AWS, including managing infrastructure as code. Terraform is what we use; another tool is fine.
  • Solid Linux, container, and version control practice.
  • You have built at least one AI-assisted workflow you still use, and you can say what it replaced and how you know it works.
  • A track record of picking up unfamiliar tools quickly, more than any specific tool on your resume.
  • Clear written communication, including documentation someone else can act on.

Strong candidates may also have

  • Direct WDL or Nextflow experience.
  • Familiarity with AWS Batch or HealthOmics.
  • Enough scientific curiosity to understand the biology behind the pipeline and ask useful questions about it.

jobs.description:
We're hiring a growth Product Manager to own the buyer side of InPost's ecommerce marketplace – acquisition, activation, retention.

Millions of people in Europe already receive parcels through InPost. Far fewer of them start their shopping with us. Closing that gap is the job. You'll own the buyer funnel end to end: how we communicate the USP, how first-time buyers get onboarded, what makes them come back for a second order, and where they drop off in between.

This is an experimentation role, not a spec-writing role. You'll run a high-velocity test pipeline with engineering, design and data, and use what you learn to argue for bigger bets. You'll also work inside a two-sided marketplace, so buyer-side wins have to hold up against seller-side incentives — that tension is part of the work, not a distraction from it.

What you'll do:

  • Own activation, conversion and retention metrics for the buyer funnel including the targets.
  • Run experimentation as a pipeline: hypothesis, sizing, test, analysis, rollout or kill. Weekly cadence, not quarterly.
  • Hunt friction across USP communication, awareness, activation, engagement, discovery and onboarding and remove it.
  • Turn funnel analysis into roadmap bets, and build the case for the expensive ones with evidence.
  • Work directly with marketing and commercial teams on demand generation and offer mechanics..
  • Balance buyer incentives against seller economics, and be explicit about the trade-off you're making.
  • Ship, measure, and say out loud when something didn't work.

What you'll need

  • 3+ years in product management, ideally growth, marketplace or ecommerce.
  • Real experience running experiments - you can explain how you sized a test, what you did about an inconclusive result, and a hypothesis of yours that turned out to be wrong.
  • Fluency in funnel analytics. You pull your own numbers and don't outsource your judgement to a dashboard.
  • A working model of two-sided marketplace dynamics.
  • Bias toward shipping and measuring over perfecting.
  • Experience where growth work is close to commercial operations, not just to marketing.
  • Ability to hold a position with stakeholders when the data supports it.
  • Polish and English, fluent.

Not a fit if

  • You want a stable roadmap defined by someone else.
  • You measure your impact in features shipped.
  • You'd rather run one perfect launch than twenty imperfect tests.

jobs.description:
Contracts Administrator – Contract Lifecycle Management & Legal Operations

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Contracts Administrator to manage the full contract lifecycle — from intake and drafting through approvals, execution, storage, renewals, compliance tracking, and reporting.

This is a highly detail-oriented and process-driven role for someone who understands that effective contract administration is critical to reducing legal, financial, and operational risk.

You’ll work cross-functionally with Legal, Procurement, Finance, Sales, Security, Compliance, and executive stakeholders to ensure agreements move efficiently while remaining accurate, compliant, properly approved, and audit-ready.

What You’ll Own

Contract Intake & Lifecycle Management

  • Manage contract requests including:
    • NDAs
    • MSAs
    • SOWs
    • DPAs
    • Vendor agreements
    • Amendments
    • Renewals
  • Review requests for completeness before initiating contract workflows.
  • Confirm business terms, pricing, counterparties, jurisdictions, and compliance requirements.
  • Route agreements through appropriate review and approval processes.
  • Track contract status and maintain execution timelines against established SLAs.

Contract Drafting, Review & Redlining

  • Draft and format agreements using approved templates and clause libraries.
  • Redline contracts using Microsoft Word Track Changes.
  • Apply approved legal playbooks and fallback language.
  • Identify and escalate non-standard provisions involving:
    • Indemnification
    • Limitation of liability
    • Intellectual property
    • Data privacy and security
    • Termination rights
    • Service-level agreements
  • Maintain clear records of contract deviations, approvals, and rationale.

Approvals & Contract Governance

  • Coordinate contract reviews across:
    • Legal
    • Finance
    • Procurement
    • Information Security
    • Privacy
    • Leadership
  • Verify pricing, budget approvals, vendor documentation, and compliance requirements.
  • Ensure contracts follow established approval matrices and governance policies.
  • Follow up with stakeholders to prevent unnecessary delays.

Execution & Contract Repository Management

  • Manage electronic signature workflows using platforms such as DocuSign or Adobe Sign.
  • Confirm signer authority and signature requirements.
  • Ensure fully executed agreements are properly stored.
  • Maintain accurate records within CLM and contract management platforms such as:
    • Ironclad
    • Icertis
    • Agiloft
    • ContractWorks
    • Conga
    • SharePoint
  • Maintain contract metadata including value, renewal dates, notice periods, jurisdiction, and data-processing requirements.

Renewals, Obligations & Compliance

  • Track:
    • Contract expiration dates
    • Renewal deadlines
    • Auto-renewal provisions
    • Notice periods
    • Pricing escalators
    • Contractual obligations
  • Maintain proactive reminders to prevent missed deadlines.
  • Support compliance requirements involving GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and internal controls.
  • Maintain complete approval, execution, and signature trails for audit readiness.

Reporting & Process Improvement

  • Track and report on:
    • Contract cycle times
    • SLA adherence
    • Renewal pipelines
    • Clause deviations
    • Standard-term usage
  • Improve contract templates, clause libraries, workflows, and documentation.
  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive contract administration processes.
  • Help develop scalable and self-service contracting workflows.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 2+ years of experience in contracts administration, contract lifecycle management, legal operations, procurement operations, or a related function.
  • Hands-on experience managing contracts throughout their lifecycle.
  • Experience with CLM systems, contract repositories, and e-signature workflows.
  • Strong proficiency with:
    • Microsoft Word Track Changes
    • Excel or Google Sheets
    • PDF editing tools
  • Working understanding of common contractual provisions including:
    • Indemnification
    • Limitation of liability
    • Confidentiality
    • Intellectual property
    • DPAs
    • SLAs
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication.
  • Ability to coordinate multiple contracts and stakeholders simultaneously.

Nice to Have

  • Experience within SaaS, technology, healthcare, finance, or regulated industries.
  • Familiarity with vendor risk management and procurement workflows.
  • Experience handling security questionnaires.
  • Experience maintaining clause libraries and contract templates.
  • Familiarity with legal playbooks and approval matrices.
  • Exposure to GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, SOX, or similar compliance frameworks.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely succeed in this role if you:

  • Catch small contractual and documentation inconsistencies quickly.
  • Enjoy structured, process-heavy work.
  • Can manage a high volume of agreements without sacrificing accuracy.
  • Follow deadlines closely and proactively manage renewals.
  • Communicate effectively across legal and non-legal teams.
  • Understand when an issue can follow standard process and when it needs escalation.
  • Take ownership of contracts from initial request through final execution and ongoing management.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may include reviewing new contract requests, drafting or redlining agreements, coordinating internal approvals, managing DocuSign workflows, updating CLM records, monitoring upcoming renewals, checking contractual obligations, and preparing contract reporting.

You’ll also work with stakeholders to resolve bottlenecks and continuously improve contracting processes.

In short: you ensure contracts move efficiently while remaining accurate, compliant, properly approved, searchable, and proactively managed throughout their lifecycle.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Contracts executed within SLA timelines.
  • Zero missed renewal or notice deadlines.
  • High contract metadata accuracy.
  • Complete and audit-ready documentation.
  • Reduced contract cycle times.
  • Consistent adherence to approval workflows.
  • Reduced non-standard clause deviations.
  • Strong stakeholder satisfaction with contract operations.

Why This Role Stands Out

  • High-impact role supporting critical business operations.
  • Cross-functional exposure to Legal, Finance, Procurement, Compliance, and leadership.
  • Opportunity to improve and scale contract lifecycle processes.
  • Strong ownership over contract governance and operational accuracy.
  • Career growth opportunities into:
    • Legal Operations Manager
    • Contract Manager
    • Procurement Operations
    • Commercial Operations
    • Contract Management Leadership

Interview Process

  1. Initial Phone Screen
  2. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  3. Practical Task – NDA Redlining Exercise / Contract Tracker Creation
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer & Background Verification

Apply Now

If you have experience in contract administration or legal operations, enjoy managing detailed workflows, and can keep high-volume agreements accurate, compliant, and organized from intake through renewal, we’d love to hear from you.

This is a strong opportunity for someone who excels at contract lifecycle management, legal operations, and process accuracy.

We’re looking for our next Channel Champion to join the team as Head of Revenue Operations!

About Channelscaler

Channelscaler is transforming how companies scale through their partners.Our AI-powered platform automates and simplifies partner engagement — from onboarding and incentives to performance tracking — helping vendors and partners grow faster together.

With one unified system, companies manage their entire partner lifecycle with ease and clarity. We’re building a category-defining company rooted in expertise, empathy, and innovation — and we’re just getting started.

About the Role

As the Head of Revenue Operations, reporting to the VP of Finance, you’ll own the systems, data, and forecasting discipline that our executive team and board rely on to run the business.

This is a build role. You’llestablish the forecasting rigor, reporting standards, and data foundation a company at our stage needs to operate predictably, and you’ll partner across Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and Finance to make those standards hold.

You’ll own the weekly forecast process outright and hold a standing seat in board reporting, quarterly business reviews, and annual planning. This role is central to how Channelscaler plans, measures, and defends its revenue performance.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll focus on delivering results that move both the team and company forward by:

  • Own forecasting and planning, including the weekly forecast, pipeline review cadence, and the reforecast standards senior leadership and investors rely on.
  • Build a single, trusted source of revenue truth across ARR, pipeline, and retention reporting that reconciles to Finance and holds up to board scrutiny.
  • Instrument retention economics, including net and gross revenue retention, renewal forecasting, churn cohorts, and expansion, so leakage surfaces early enough to act on.
  • Own the GTM technology roadmap (Salesforce, HubSpot, Salesloft, DealHub, and related tools), the data governance behind it.
  • Design pricing, segmentation, and territory strategy grounded in ICP, and implement it in the CRM.
  • Identify and lead efficiency gains through AI and automation, from scoring and forecasting models to workflow design across the revenue stack.
  • Deliver executive and board materials, including board reviews, strategic planning, and QBRs, and coach the revenue operations talent around you.

What Success Looks Like

  • Forecast accuracy sustained within an agreed variance band across consecutive quarters.
  • One trusted ARR data set, reportable by product and segment, that Finance and GTM both stand behind.
  • Retention reporting that surfaces churn and expansion drivers early enough to change the outcome.
  • Quotas, segmentation, and performance objectivesimplemented on time ahead of each fiscal year.
  • A documented, governed GTM stack with every system in a company-managed tenant and access that can be audited.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 7+ years in revenue operations, sales operations, or business operations within B2B SaaS.
  • Must have hands-on experience standing up revenue operations in an unstructured or early-stage environment, including creating the processes, systems, and reporting infrastructure where little or none existed before. Candidates whose experience is limited to running a mature, already-functioning RevOps organization will not be a fit.
  • A track record owning a forecast that senior leadership and investors relied on, with a clear view of how you made it credible.
  • Depth in revenue systems architecture and data governance across CRM and marketing automation.
  • Proven ability to influence Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance without direct authority over them.

Core Competencies:

  • Systems thinking. You reason about the business first and the tooling second.
  • Ruthless prioritization. There will always be more RevOpswork here than capacity, and you decide what matters.
  • Data fluency. Comfortable in SQL and BI tools, not only CRM reporting.
  • Cross-functional credibility. You move teams you do not own.
  • Accountability. You quantify your own impact and own what did not work.

Preferred (nice to have):

  • Retention and expansion analytics in a partner, channel, or ecosystem context.
  • Applying AI or LLM tooling to scoring, forecasting, or GTM analytics.
  • Business intelligence, analytics, and data science experience.
  • M&A, carve-out, or post-acquisition integration experience

Location & Work Environment

Channelscaler is a remote-first company with team members across the U.S., Ireland, India, and the U.K. For this role, we prefer candidates based in the Eastern Standard Time zone. Minimal travel expected (10 - 15% annually).

What We Offer

We thrive in a collaborative, growth-oriented environment that values curiosity and ownership.

  • 25 days of paid time off annually
  • 12 dedicated training days per year for professional development
  • Paid parental leave

  • 401(k) match
  • Fully remote work environment with flexible hours
  • Annual team offsites and opportunities for in-person collaboration

jobs.title: Senior Python Engineer - AI Coding Agent Evaluation (Freelance)
jobs.excerpt: Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.
jobs.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.What this opportunity involves:
We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT:

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for:

  • 8+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard:
Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

How it works
Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paidEffort estimate

Tasks for this project are estimated to take 30 hours to complete, depending on complexity. This is an estimate and not a schedule requirement; you choose when and how to work. Tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet the listed acceptance criteria to be accepted.

Compensation:
Up to $200/hr equivalent, depending on level and pace. Tasks are estimated at ~30 hours each; you set your own schedule.

Why Pythian:

At Pythian, we are experts in strategic database and analytics services, driving digital transformation and operational excellence. Pythian, a multinational company, was founded in 1997 and started by ensuring the reliability and performance of mission-critical databases. We quickly earned a reputation for solving tough data challenges. We were there when the industry moved from on-premises to cloud environments, and as enterprises sought more from their data, we expanded our competencies to include advanced analytics.

Today, we empower organizations to embrace transformation and leverage advanced technologies, including AI, to stay competitive. We deliver innovative solutions that meet each client’s data goals and have built strong partnerships with Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, SAP, and Snowflake. The powerful combination of our extensive expertise in data and cloud and our ability to keep on top of the latest bleeding edge technologies make us the perfect partner to help mid and large-sized businesses transform to stay ahead in today’s rapidly changing digital economy.

Why you:

Pythian sits at the intersection of data engineering, AI production, and managed services — helping enterprises turn data complexity into competitive advantage. With three decades of deep managed services heritage and strategic partnerships across the leading cloud and database technology ecosystems, we are at the forefront of helping clients move from AI experimentation to AI in production.

We are looking for a polished, quota-carrying Senior Sales Executive who is energized by the AI moment and knows how to help enterprise clients build the modern, well-managed data foundations that make production AI possible at scale. You are comfortable hunting new logos, converting inbound leads, and growing existing accounts. You bring credibility in conversations about Database Managed Services, Production AI, and cloud and database technologies — and you know how to co-sell effectively with OEM and hyperscaler partners to drive mutual value.

What Makes This Role Unique:

Pythian’s portfolio spans the full stack from data foundations to production AI — Production AI, Database Managed Services, AI Strategy & Automation, Data Migrations, Cloud Consulting, and Agentic AI solutions, supported by partnerships across Google Cloud, Oracle, AWS, Microsoft Azure, SAP, and the broader modern data ecosystem. This means you’re never selling a point solution; you’re building long-term, high-value partnerships with clients who want a trusted advisor to help them scale intelligently.

If you’re energized by the AI transformation happening across enterprise technology right now, know how to sell complex managed services, and want to represent a company with deep technical credibility and a growing AI practice — this role is built for you.

What you will be doing:

Territory & Pipeline

  • Build and execute a territory plan with a disciplined mix of new logo hunting, inbound conversion, and account expansion.
  • Maintain a robust, accurately forecasted pipeline in Salesforce; provide weekly pipeline reviews and revenue projections.
  • Develop targeted account strategies for key prospects in retail, manufacturing, logistics, financial services, and other enterprise verticals.
  • Identify and pursue net-new logos while deepening relationships and expanding wallet share within existing accounts.

AI & Data Services Sales

  • Lead discovery and solution conversations around Production AI, AI Strategy, Agentic AI, and AI Automation with enterprise buyers (CAIO, CDO, CTO, CIO).
  • Articulate how modern, well-managed data estates — across databases, cloud data platforms, and data migrations — are the critical scaffolding for scalable AI.
  • Sell the business case for Database Managed Services and DBA Support, connecting operational reliability to AI readiness and cost efficiency.
  • Help clients understand Pythian’s phased “Data Foundations to Production AI” journey and position appropriate entry points based on their maturity.

Partner & OEM Co-sell

  • Co-sell with hyperscaler and OEM field teams — including Google Cloud, Oracle — to drive joint pipeline and leverage partner co-sell programs, Marketplace motions, and funded assessment opportunities.
  • Navigate partner deal registration, funding programs, and co-sell qualification processes across multiple technology ecosystems to accelerate deal velocity and protect margin.
  • Build and maintain strong field relationships with partner account teams, knowing how to activate the right partner resources at the right stage of a deal.
  • Serve as the primary relationship owner for your accounts while leveraging Pythian’s delivery, solutions, and field CTO resources as needed.

Deal Execution & Internal Orchestration

  • Lead enterprise sales cycles end-to-end: discovery, business case development, proposal, negotiation, and close.
  • Act as the internal project manager for your deals — coordinating across Solutions Architecture, Delivery, Legal, and Finance to keep complex cycles moving, ensure scope integrity, and deliver proposals on time.
  • Know when and how to engage the right internal resources (Field CTO, practice leads, delivery SMEs) and manage those relationships to build credibility with prospects without over-committing delivery capacity.
  • Prepare and present compelling proposals, RFP responses, and executive-level business case materials.
  • Document client interactions, capture competitive intelligence, and share win/loss insights to continuously improve Pythian’s go-to-market.

Travel as required to attend client meetings, partner events, industry conferences, and Pythian’s annual sales kickoff.

What we need from you:

  • 10+ years of enterprise technology sales experience with a consistent record of meeting or exceeding quota.

Data & Systems Lead

Remote | August 2026

United We Dream (UWD) is the largest immigrant youth-led community in the country. We create welcoming spaces for young people – regardless of immigration status – to make their voices heard and win victories so that all people can live free and thrive. We recruit, support, engage and empower young people and are creating a new generation of social justice leaders to change our world.

Our powerful network is made up of 1.2 million members, over 100 local groups across 28 states, and we reach over 5 million people online every month. We celebrate our diversity and believe in multi-ethnic, multi-racial, inter-generational intersectional solutions. Over 60% of our members are womxn and 20% identify as LGBTQ.

Whether we’re organizing in the streets, building innovative technology systems, opening doors for LGBTQ immigrant youth, clearing pathways to education, stopping deportations, or creating alliances across social movements, United We Dream puts undocumented immigrant youth in the driver’s seat. United We Dream is a fast-paced, dynamic organization which has become a leading voice in social change and has appeared in every major news outlet in the country.

We are driven by the priorities and needs of our members; have trained thousands of individuals; and have supported countless local organizing groups. Today, United We Dream is arguably the most influential immigrant rights organization in the nation and a leading driver of progressive politics and strategy. Our brand is known around the world and we are proud to be driven by the hopes, dreams, decisions, and brilliance of directly impacted young people.

Learn more about United We Dream by visiting .

POSITION SUMMARY

Come join United We Dream’s (UWD) Data and Technology Team! At UWD, technology and data play a critical role in advancing our mission of achieving dignity for our families and undocumented people across the country. We are looking for a visionary and collaborative team member who understands grassroots organizing, values the power of data, and approaches technological challenges with a solutions-oriented mindset: “let’s find a solution.”

The Lead, Data & Systems is ideal for someone who is experienced with and passionate about supporting organizations focused on grassroots and distributed organizing. This role uses data and technology to strengthen organizing efforts by helping teams access the information, tools, and systems they need to do what they do best - organize.

Reporting to the Director of Organizational Culture & Systems, the Data & Systems Lead serves as a technical expert and trusted partner who strengthens organizational data capacity, supports the implementation and optimization of platform features, and identifies, tests, and implements innovative solutions. Guided by the organization's strategic goals, this role ensures data is collected accurately and consistently, improves workflows, streamlines data processes, strengthens data practices, and enhances overall data management.

The ideal candidate is a proactive, self-directed professional who exercises sound judgment, takes initiative to solve complex problems, and collaborates effectively across departments to strengthen organizational capacity through data and technology.

Data & Systems Strategy and Governance

  • Alignment.
