Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

What this opportunity involves

We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard

Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Effort estimate

Tasks for this project are estimated to take 20 hours to complete, depending on complexity. This is an estimate and not a schedule requirement; you choose when and how to work. Tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet the listed acceptance criteria to be accepted.

Compensation

jobs.description:
The Accountant – Accounts Payable is responsible for the accurate and timely processing of invoices, vendor payments, and related financial transactions for a real estate company. This position supports the accounting department in maintaining organized, audit-ready AP records, managing vendor relationships, and ensuring that all payables are processed in accordance with company policies and internal controls. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, dependable, and eager to build a career in real estate accounting.

Key Responsibilities

Invoice Processing & Payment Execution

  • Receive, review, and code vendor invoices to the appropriate property, cost center, and general ledger account in accordance with the chart of accounts.
  • Match invoices against purchase orders, contracts, and approved work orders; identify and resolve discrepancies prior to payment approval.
  • Enter and post invoices into the accounting system (Yardi, MRI, AppFolio, or equivalent) accurately and within established processing timelines.
  • Prepare weekly and bi-weekly payment runs including checks, ACH transfers, and wire payments; route for proper authorization prior to release.
  • Ensure all invoices are approved by the appropriate property manager, project manager, or department head before payment is issued.
  • Process utility payments, CAM reconciliation billings, property tax installments, mortgage payments, and other recurring property-level obligations on schedule.

Vendor Management & Communication

  • Maintain a current and organized vendor database including contact information, payment terms, W-9s, and certificates of insurance.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for vendor payment inquiries; research and resolve payment disputes, short pays, and billing discrepancies in a professional and timely manner.
  • Assist with new vendor onboarding, including obtaining required documentation such as W-9 forms, ACH authorization agreements, and insurance certificates.
  • Monitor vendor statements and reconcile outstanding balances on a regular basis to ensure accounts remain current and accurate.

Recordkeeping & Filing

  • Maintain organized digital and physical files for all invoices, payment confirmations, vendor contracts, and supporting documentation in accordance with document retention policies.
  • Ensure all AP transactions are supported by complete and accurate backup documentation that is audit-ready at all times.
  • Assist with month-end close by preparing AP aging reports, accrual schedules, and outstanding invoice summaries for review by the Controller.
  • Reconcile AP sub-ledger to the general ledger on a monthly basis and investigate and resolve any variances.

Month-End Close Support

  • Prepare and post accrual journal entries for invoices received but not yet processed at month-end.
  • Assist with bank reconciliations by identifying and clearing outstanding AP-related items.
  • Generate and distribute monthly AP aging reports to property managers and senior accounting staff.
  • Support the Controller or Accounting Manager with any ad hoc reporting, analysis, or reconciliation tasks required during the close cycle.

Compliance & Internal Controls

  • Process all invoices and payments in strict accordance with the company’s AP policies, approval authority matrix, and internal control procedures.
  • Identify and flag duplicate invoices, unapproved expenditures, or payments that fall outside established thresholds for supervisor review.
  • Assist with annual 1099 preparation and filing, ensuring all applicable vendors are identified and reported accurately and on time.
  • Support internal and external audit requests by retrieving invoices, transaction detail, and supporting documentation as directed.

Cross-Departmental Collaboration

  • Coordinate with property managers to obtain invoice approvals, resolve coding questions, and ensure property-level expenses are accurately captured.
  • Work closely with the asset management and construction teams to process capital expenditure invoices and draw requests in accordance with approved budgets.
  • Assist with the setup and tracking of vendor payment schedules for construction and renovation projects.
  • Communicate proactively with team members regarding aging payables, cash requirements, and payment timing.

Qualifications

Required

  • Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field; or equivalent combination of education and work experience.
  • 3–5 years of accounts payable or general accounting experience; real estate or property management industry experience a plus.
  • Working knowledge of accounts payable processes, general ledger coding, and basic accounting principles (debits, credits, accruals).
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (VLOOKUP, pivot tables, basic formulas) and Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Experience with property management or accounting software (Yardi, MRI, AppFolio, QuickBooks, or similar) preferred.
  • Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to manage a high volume of invoices accurately and efficiently.
  • Dependable and deadline-driven with a strong sense of urgency around month-end and payment run timelines.

Preferred

  • Experience in commercial real estate, property management, or a multi-entity accounting environment.
  • Familiarity with CAM reconciliations, property tax billing cycles, and lease abstracts as they relate to AP.
  • Understanding of 1099 reporting requirements and year-end AP processes.
  • Exposure to job cost accounting or project-based expense tracking.

Core Competencies

  • Accuracy & Attention to Detail: Consistently produces error-free work in a high-volume, fast-paced environment.
  • Organization: Able to manage multiple invoices, deadlines, and vendor relationships simultaneously without items being missed.
  • Communication: Professional and clear in all written and verbal interactions with vendors, property managers, and internal team members.
  • Integrity: Handles sensitive financial information with discretion and adheres to all internal controls and approval processes.
  • Eagerness to Learn: Open to feedback, proactive in developing accounting knowledge, and motivated to grow within the organization.
  • Team Collaboration: Works cooperatively with accounting colleagues and cross-functional departments to meet shared deadlines.

Work Environment

This is a fully remote position with standard business hours Monday through Friday. During month-end close and year-end periods, additional hours may be required to meet reporting deadlines. The role requires reliable internet connectivity, a dedicated and professional remote workspace, sustained computer use, data entry, and regular communication with vendors and internal stakeholders via phone, email, Zoom, Microsoft Teams, or similar collaboration platforms.



Remote Work Requirements
1. Must have a reliable high-speed internet connection and backup connectivity option.
2. Must have access to a quiet and professional work environment suitable for remote collaboration and meetings.
3. Ability to work independently, manage time effectively, and maintain productivity in a remote setting.
4. Comfortable using remote communication and project management tools such as Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Slack, ClickUp, or similar platforms.
5. Availability to work within the company’s designated business hours and attend virtual meetings as required.

jobs.excerpt: Group 1001is a consumer-centric, technology-driven family of insurance companies on a mission to deliver outstanding value and operational performance by combining financial strength and stability with deep insurance expertise and a can-do culture.
jobs.description:
Group 1001is a consumer-centric, technology-driven family of insurance companies on a mission to deliver outstanding value and operational performance by combining financial strength and stability with deep insurance expertise and a can-do culture. Group1001’s culture emphasizes the importance of collaboration, communication, core business focus, risk management, and striving for outcomes. This goal extends to how we hire and onboard our most valuable assets – our employees.

Why This Role Matters:

This position sits with the Group 1001's Next-Gen Operations Technology team. The person in this role makes operations work better by understanding how it runs, then re-engineering it to improve efficiency. You map the current-state process, find where time, rework, and hand-offs are lost, and redesign the process so it runs cleaner and simpler. You will use operational data to prove where the problem is and to measure whether the change works. In addition, you design the fixes alongside the technology teams that build them. This is a process-and-solutions seat grounded in Lean / Six Sigma and continuous-improvement discipline, not a heads-down coding seat. Success is partnering to make this land with IT, Distribution, Compliance, Product, and Audit across annuity operations, and with operational leadership, front-line leaders, the quality team, and the process-improvement team to keep procedures effective, streamlined, and as simple as possible.

How You’ll Contribute:

  • Map and diagnose operational processes: value-stream and process mapping of how the work runs today; find the waste, the rework loops, and the failure points.
  • Re-engineer and improve run structured improvement (DMAIC or equivalent) to redesign processes so they are faster, cleaner, more reliable, and more efficient.
  • Use data as the diagnostic: pull and analyze operational data to locate the problem, size it, and measure whether the change worked. Partner with the ops data product owner for the trusted measures; you interpret them and act.
  • Own the process-improvement portfolio like a product owner: pick the processes most worth fixing, sequence the work, hold the priorities, and represent operations to the delivery teams.
  • Design the solution in partnership with the technology teams: When a process requires a system enhancement, platform integration, or automation, produce the to-be process and solution design plus clear requirements, then work in tandem with the delivery teams (internal, engineering, DSS, vendors) so the design and execution meet production needs.

What We’re Looking For:

  • 8+ years in process engineering, continuous improvement, or a data-heavy process-analyst role, with a track record of processes measurably improved (cycle time, rework, quality, or cost).
  • Prior experience in Insurance, financial services, or other regulated-industry background is highly desired
  • Lean / Six Sigma discipline: Green Belt minimum, Black Belt a plus; comfortable running DMAIC and standard process-mapping methods.
  • Strong data analysis experience: you can pull, interrogate, and interpret operational data to diagnose a process and prove an improvement, without needing to own the data platform.
  • Solution-design instinct: you can design a to-be process and the shape of the system or automation that supports it, write clear requirements, and partner with a delivery team to get it built.
  • Product-owner instincts: you prioritize and sequence the work, hold a backlog, and represent the operation to the teams that build.
  • Real understanding of operations processes and projects; you can sit with a team, learn how the work runs, and see where it breaks.
  • Clear communicator who can work across operations, engineering, vendors, and leadership.
  • Intellectual curiosity: you ask why a process looks the way it does, dig into the discrepancies, and keep learning.
  • Contact-center / customer-operations process experience is preferred
  • Familiarity with where automation and AI reduce work from the process is preferred
  • Prior experience in BI tooling, Visio or Lucid chart for mapping; SQL or a BI tool for the data side is preferred but not required
  • Be curious enough to understand the work before you plan it
  • Show empathy for the teams whose work you're changing
  • Confident giving feedback and humble receiving feedback
  • Demonstrate flexibility when priorities shift
  • Be resilient, calm, and have a good, humored attitude when things don’t go as planned

Compensation: 

Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several U.S. geographic markets. The base pay for this position ranges from $130,000/year in our lowest geographic market up to $155,000/year plus bonus in our highest geographic market. Pay is based on a number of factors including market location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

Benefits Highlights:

Employees who meet benefit eligibility guidelines and work 30 hours or more weekly, have the ability to enroll in Group 1001’s benefits package. Employees (and their families) are eligible to participate in the Company’s comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance plan options. Employees are also eligible for Basic and Supplemental Life Insurance, Short and Long-Term Disability. All employees (regardless of hours worked) have immediate access to the Company’s Employee Assistance Program and wellness programs—no enrollment is required. Employees may also participate in the Company’s 401K plan, with matching contributions by the Company.

Group 1001, and its affiliated companies, is strongly committed to providing a supportive work environment where employee differences are valued. Diversity is an essential ingredient in making Group 1001 a welcoming place to work and is fundamental in building a high-performance team. Diversity embodies all the differences that make us unique individuals. All employees share the responsibility for maintaining a workplace culture of dignity, respect, understanding and appreciation of individual and group differences.

jobs.description:
May Mobility is transforming cities through autonomous technology to create a safer, greener, more accessible world. Based in Ann Arbor, Michigan, May develops and deploys autonomous vehicles (AVs) powered by our innovative Multi-Policy Decision Making (MPDM) technology that literally reimagines the way AVs think.

Our vehicles do more than just drive themselves - they provide value to communities, bridge public transit gaps and move people where they need to go safely, easily and with a lot more fun. We’re building the world’s best autonomy system to reimagine transit by minimizing congestion, expanding access and encouraging better land use in order to foster more green, vibrant and livable spaces. Since our founding in 2017, we’ve given more than 500,000 autonomous rides to real people around the globe. And we’re just getting started. We’re hiring people who share our passion for building the future, today, solving real-world problems and seeing the impact of their work. Join us.

Job Summary

May Mobility is seeking a Lead, Safety Assurance to serve as the company's primary authority on autonomous vehicle safety compliance. Reporting to the Legal team and supporting the engineering safety team, this senior subject matter expert role operates independently from the engineering Safety organization to provide an objective, compliance-anchored perspective on May Mobility's safety posture. This person will lead regulatory engagement on safety matters end-to-end—from monitoring emerging federal and state requirements to leading NHTSA correspondence, reviewing SGO incident narratives, and maintaining the compliance documentation that underpins May Mobility's ability to operate and expand.

This role requires someone who combines deep regulatory expertise with firsthand knowledge of how federal safety frameworks apply in practice—and who can translate that knowledge into durable internal processes appropriate in an agile startup environment, credible external submissions, and sound counsel to Safety and Legal leadership.

Essential Responsibilities

NHTSA & SGO Leadership

  • Review, quality-assure, and approve SGO incident narratives prior to submission, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and appropriate framing
  • Monitor NHTSA and state enforcement trends, proposed rulemakings, safety guidance, and regulatory developments at the state and federal levels; proactively surface implications to Safety and Legal leadership
  • Support responses to NHTSA investigations or enforcement actions, coordinating with outside counsel and internal stakeholders as needed

Regulatory Compliance & Gap Analysis

  • Monitor federal and state AV regulatory requirements and assess alignment with May Mobility’s internal safety policies, identifying gaps where internal standards fall short of the regulatory floor
  • Support development of internal safety benchmarks, including review of the company SMS calibrated against applicable federal standards, including FMVSS, NHTSA frameworks, SAE standards, and other industry best practices
  • Participate in enterprise risk management activities with a regulatory consequence lens, assessing whether identified operational risks carry regulatory implications
  • Track emerging ADS-related guidance, enforcement trends, and state-level rulemakings; maintain a current regulatory landscape view for leadership

Compliance Documentation & Submissions

  • Create and maintain a comprehensive library of compliance documentation, including regulatory context summaries, gap analyses, submission records, and background materials
  • Prepare and review safety-relevant regulatory submissions and correspondence, ensuring accuracy of safety content and appropriate routing through Legal prior to submission
  • Prepare supporting documentation for regulatory engagements where safety posture is relevant, including materials for meetings with state DOTs, federal agencies, and other stakeholders

Safety Assurance & Cross-Functional Advisory

  • Advise on passenger and public safety best practices informed by federal standards, NTSB findings, and industry precedent; support their operationalization within May Mobility’s safety programs
  • Provide regulatory compliance perspective to Safety leadership on safety case development, incident response, and operational risk decisions
  • Coordinate with outside counsel on regulatory strategy, submission review, and government engagement as needed
  • Brief executive and Legal leadership on regulatory developments, compliance status, and recommended response actions

Skills and Abilities

Success in this role typically requires the following competencies:

  • Exceptional written communication skills; able to translate complex technical safety content into accurate, defensible regulatory language
  • Ability to operate independently and exercise sound judgment across ambiguous, high-stakes situations

Qualifications and Experience

Candidates most successful in this role typically hold the following qualifications or comparable knowledge or experience:

  • 7+ years of experience in AV safety regulation, incident management, or safety compliance within NHTSA, a federal agency, or an AV/automotive company
  • Deep familiarity with NHTSA’s Standing General Order (SGO) reporting requirements and crash investigation processes
  • Hands-on experience with FMVSS, NHTSA exemption frameworks, and SAE ADS taxonomy
  • Proven ability to prepare and manage regulatory submissions, safety correspondence, and compliance documentation
  • Experience working closely with or alongside legal counsel on regulatory matters and strategy

Preferred

  • Prior experience at NHTSA’s Office of Automation Safety, Office of Vehicle Safety Compliance, or equivalent federal safety office
  • Background in crash reconstruction, forensic engineering, or ADS safety case evaluation
  • Experience briefing senior leadership or executive teams on incident trends and regulatory strategy
  • Graduate degree in mechanical engineering, safety engineering, or a related technical field
  • Experience working within cross-functional teams to manage safety critical issues

Physical Requirements

  • Standard office working conditions which includes but not limited to:
    • Prolonged sitting
    • Prolonged standing
    • Prolonged computer use
  • Travel Required?Minimal: 1%-10%

Benefits and Perks

  • Comprehensive healthcare suite including medical, dental, vision, life, and disability plans. Domestic partners who have been residing together at least one year are also eligible to participate.
  • Health Savings and Flexible Spending Healthcare and Dependent Care Accounts available.
  • Rich retirement benefits, including an immediately vested employer safe harbor match.
  • Generous paid parental leave as well as a phased return to work.
  • Flexible vacation policy in addition to paid company holidays.
  • Total Wellness Program providing numerous resources for overall wellbeing
Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and/or people of color are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every qualification. At May Mobility, we’re committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workforce, so if you’re excited about this role but your previous experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway! You may be the perfect candidate for this or another role at May.

Want to learn more about our culture & benefits? Check out our website!

If you believe that you will need any type of accommodation, please let us know.

jobs.description:
Location: Remote – South Africa
Sector: Technology & Finance
Employment Type: Full-time
Working Hours: 09:00–17:00 UK time, Monday to Friday

Role Overview

Our client is a specialist UK-based executive search consultancy operating across the Technology and Finance sectors. They are seeking an experienced and polished Senior Executive Search Resourcer to support senior-level and executive search assignments across the UK, Europe and the United States.

This role is focused on identifying, engaging and qualifying high-calibre professionals at Director, VP, C-suite and senior leadership level.

This is not a high-volume recruitment or CV sourcing position. The successful candidate will be expected to take a highly targeted, research-led and consultative approach to executive search. You will build detailed market maps, approach passive candidates with credibility, conduct meaningful qualification conversations and develop long-term relationships with senior professionals.

You will work closely with Executive Search Consultants and Partners, providing high-quality candidate intelligence, market insight and research throughout the search lifecycle.

Requirements

Primary Responsibilities

  • Identify and headhunt senior-level candidates across specialist Technology and Finance markets.
  • Conduct detailed market mapping to identify relevant companies, teams, leadership structures and potential candidates.
  • Source candidates through LinkedIn Recruiter, professional networks, internal databases and targeted research.
  • Engage passive candidates at Director, VP, C-suite and executive level in a professional and credible manner.
  • Conduct detailed candidate qualification and screening calls.
  • Assess candidates based on experience, leadership capability, career motivations, compensation expectations and future objectives.
  • Build a strong understanding of each candidate's professional background and suitability for specific executive search assignments.
  • Present well-qualified and accurately documented candidate profiles to the Executive Search Consultant or Partner.
  • Build and maintain long-term relationships with senior professionals, rather than engaging candidates solely for immediate vacancies.
  • Maintain regular communication and follow-up with candidates throughout the search process.
  • Gather market intelligence relating to organisational structures, senior appointments, leadership movements and competitor activity.
  • Identify potential commercial intelligence and business development opportunities uncovered through candidate conversations and market research.
  • Maintain accurate candidate records, notes, search activity and follow-up actions within the ATS and CRM.
  • Support the preparation of candidate reports, market maps, longlists, shortlists and search documentation.
  • Assist with interview coordination and candidate management throughout the recruitment process.
  • Provide ongoing market feedback to Consultants regarding candidate availability, compensation trends and market sentiment.
  • Contribute to the continuous development of the firm's candidate network across Technology and Finance.

Qualifications and Experience

The successful candidate should have:

  • A minimum of 3 years' experience within executive search, permanent recruitment, recruitment research or senior-level resourcing.
  • Proven experience sourcing and engaging Director, VP, C-suite or other senior-level professionals.
  • Previous experience working within executive search or a highly targeted headhunting environment is strongly preferred.
  • Experience recruiting internationally, ideally across the UK, Europe and/or United States.
  • Strong market mapping and candidate research skills.
  • Proven ability to identify and engage passive candidates.
  • Excellent candidate qualification and consultative interviewing skills.
  • Confidence discussing senior-level career moves, motivations, compensation and leadership experience.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Excellent relationship-building skills and the ability to establish credibility with senior professionals.
  • Strong commercial awareness and an understanding of how candidate conversations can generate useful market and business intelligence.
  • Experience using LinkedIn Recruiter, ATS platforms and CRM systems.
  • Strong attention to detail and accurate candidate documentation.
  • Excellent organisational and time-management skills.
  • The ability to manage multiple executive search assignments simultaneously.
  • The ability to work independently in a remote environment while collaborating closely with the wider search team.

Technology & Finance Market Exposure

Experience recruiting within one or more of the following areas would be advantageous:

Technology

  • Software and SaaS
  • FinTech
  • Data and Analytics
  • Artificial Intelligence
  • Cybersecurity
  • Cloud and Infrastructure
  • Digital Transformation
  • Technology Leadership
  • Product and Engineering
  • IT Services and Consulting

Finance

  • Financial Services
  • Banking
  • Private Equity
  • Investment Management
  • FinTech
  • Corporate Finance
  • Accounting and Finance Leadership
  • Risk and Compliance
  • Insurance
  • CFO and senior finance leadership appointments

Candidates do not necessarily need experience across both Technology and Finance, provided they have strong executive search expertise within a relevant specialist market.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate will be:

  • Professional, polished and credible when communicating with senior executives.
  • Naturally inquisitive and comfortable asking detailed questions.
  • Consultative rather than transactional in their approach.
  • Confident speaking with Director, VP and C-suite professionals.
  • Skilled at building trust and developing long-term candidate relationships.
  • Comfortable challenging candidates and thoroughly assessing their suitability.
  • Commercially aware and able to recognise valuable market intelligence.
  • Research-driven and able to understand complex organisational structures and specialist markets.
  • Persistent and confident when approaching passive candidates.
  • Highly organised and disciplined with follow-up.
  • Detail-oriented when recording candidate and market information.
  • Focused on delivering quality rather than volume.
  • Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of search assignments.
  • Motivated by working within a high-quality executive search environment.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this position will be measured by:

  • The quality and relevance of candidates identified.
  • Ability to engage difficult-to-reach senior professionals.
  • Quality and depth of candidate qualification.
  • Accuracy and completeness of market mapping.
  • Strength of candidate relationships developed over time.
  • Quality of candidate profiles presented to Consultants and Partners.
  • Consistency of candidate follow-up and pipeline management.
  • Quality of market intelligence gathered.
  • Contribution to successful executive search assignments.
  • Accuracy of ATS and CRM records.
  • Ability to identify potential commercial opportunities through market conversations.

Benefits

Working Requirements

  • Full-time position.
  • Monday to Friday.
  • 09:00–17:00 UK time.
  • Fully remote from South Africa.
  • Reliable internet connection and professional home-working environment required.
  • Regular telephone and video conversations with senior candidates across international markets will form a core part of the role.

The Role

At CompanyCam, the Sr. Director of Digital, Marketing Technology, and Data owns the architecture, administration, and roadmap of our MarTech stack, our marketing data strategy, and the paid and owned digital channel strategy that stack is built to support. Reporting to the SVP of Marketing and serving on the Marketing Senior Leadership Team, you'll build and lead a Marketing Operations team responsible for Marketo, 6Sense, Qualified, Webflow, and our ad platform stack, and lead a website development team with real engineers and engineering process.

This is a hands-on technical leader, not a generalist who manages people who understand the tools better than they do. You should be equally comfortable evaluating an integration decision, setting channel mix strategy, and translating marketing data into recommendations for the SLT.

Location: Remote - Candidates must permanently and currently reside in the United States.

  • Own CompanyCam's marketing data strategy, including the data model and data integrity across Marketing's systems
  • Lead the marketing website development team, owning the engineering roadmap, sprint process, and release/QA process for the marketing site
  • Lead and develop the Director of Growth Operations, Sr. Marketing Optimization Manager, Marketing Operations team, and website development team
  • Serve as the Digital, Marketing Technology, and Data voice on the Marketing Senior Leadership Team

The Impact You'll Have

At CompanyCam, your work makes a real impact. Whether you're writing code, supporting customers, or designing experiences, your contributions directly shape the product we deliver and the people we serve. We're building something that helps real people solve real problems, and we believe that kind of work is best done by a team that reflects the world around us. In this role, you'll drive impact by:

  • Building a MarTech architecture and marketing data strategy that scales with the business instead of constraining it

  • Setting a digital channel strategy that connects investment directly to pipeline and acquisition outcomes

Benefits & Compensation

This is a salaried position at CompanyCam. Our starting salary range is $195,000-$225,000 per year and is based on experience. We also offer meaningful equity and other benefits.

jobs.excerpt: About Get Covered & Revyse We provide cost-effective coverage with just a few clicks — satisfying residents, property managers, agencies, and distribution partners with a process that is as simple and touchless as possible.
jobs.description:
About Get Covered & Revyse

We provide cost-effective coverage with just a few clicks — satisfying residents, property managers, agencies, and distribution partners with a process that is as simple and touchless as possible.

Revyse helps multifamily operators discover the best vendor partners, manage

contracts and compliance, and reduce financial risk. Our platform turns vendor data

into a strategic advantage - and our newest compliance product is changing how

property management companies onboard, verify, and support vendors.

We’re a fast-moving post-acquisition startup with a big vision: overhaul how

operators and suppliers work together. Founded by industry experts and backed by

leading multifamily investors, Revyse is growing quickly - and we’re looking for

someone who loves building order from the chaos of growth.

About the role

Worth knowing before you apply, because you will meet all of it in your first month.

You support pods, not a single manager's queue. Product managers and engineers

are both your customers, and they will want different things on the same day. So will

real customers!

You have no authority to assign work. Nobody here does. Your influence comes

entirely from the quality of your context and the clarity of your case, which is either

the best part of this job or the wrong job for you.

The domain has depth and complexity. Insurance requirements vary by trade, scope

of work, and state. Compliance rules vary by customer. You will not be able to reason

about our data without learning the domain, and we will give you time to learn it.

Our documentation is uneven. Some things are written down. Many are not, and

finding out is the work rather than a blocker to it.

We are a small company post-acquisition and still forming. Your work is visible, and

so are the gaps you close.

What you'll do

If AI drafts the tickets, the quality of what gets built is decided by the context it

receives. That context is what you’ll optimize.

Understand and write down how the platform actually behaves today - the

workflows, the exception paths, the rules, and the undocumented behavior currently

living in people's heads.

Build and maintain the reference material that our AI tooling and our engineers pull

from, and keep it accurate as the product changes. Stale documentation now

produces bad tickets and bad code automatically, at scale.

Review tickets and specs against reality before anyone builds them. This is the part

that matters most: AI-generated work is confidently wrong exactly where it costs the

most - edge cases, compliance rules, customer-specific commitments, anything that

is not in the repo or the training data.

Capture acceptance criteria, edge cases, failure behavior, and explicit non-goals so a

pod can pick something up and build it without a meeting.

Qualifications

3+ years as a business analyst, technical analyst, product analyst, data analyst,

or in product operations, working closely with engineers.

● Strong SQL. You write your own queries against a real schema, you

understand what a join is doing to your row count, and you sanity-check your

results before presenting them.

● You can read a database schema and work out how a product behaves from it.

● You already work with AI as a daily tool, not an experiment. You know how to

structure context so output is reliable, you iterate on prompts rather than

accepting the first answer, and you know when a model is confidently wrong

and you check.

● You can build a rough working thing with AI assistance. Not production code.

A prototype good enough that people can react to it instead of imagining it.

● You write clearly. In a setup like ours, written clarity is not a soft skill. It is the

input that determines what gets built.

● Analytical honesty. You quantify rather than characterize, you name your

assumptions, and when numbers don't reconcile you stop and investigate

instead of shipping the chart.

● Comfort operating without process scaffolding, and comfort saying “not this

week, here's why” when three people want the same hour.

  • Bonus: B2B SaaS with enterprise customers, compliance- or workflow-heavy

products, Python for analysis, or experience maintaining documentation that

AI tooling depends on.

jobs.description:
About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

As a Sr Fraud Analyst specializing in Peer-to-Peer (P2P) and Cash Advance products, you will be on the front lines of protecting Sezzle and our customers from financial loss and malicious activity. You will leverage data analytics, investigation tools, and industry knowledge to identify, mitigate, and prevent complex fraud schemes, including Account Takeover (ATO), friendly fraud, synthetic identities, and social engineering scams.

The ideal candidate is naturally curious, highly analytical, and thrives in a fast-paced environment where fraud trends evolve rapidly.

What You'll Do:

  • Transaction Monitoring & Investigation: Conduct daily reviews of high-risk P2P transfers and cash advance requests to identify fraudulent activity. Investigate suspicious accounts and take appropriate action (e.g., freezing accounts, declining transactions).
  • Trend Analysis & Rule Optimization: Analyze fraud patterns and emerging trends to identify gaps in current defenses. Work closely with the Risk Strategy team to recommend and test new fraud rules and machine learning model features.
  • Scam & ATO Mitigation: Investigate complex fraud cases involving social engineering scams, unauthorized access (ATO), and first-party/friendly fraud specific to instant money movement.
  • Reporting: Create and maintain dashboards tracking key fraud metrics (e.g., false positive rates, fraud loss rates, operational SLAs) and report findings to leadership.

What We Look For:

  • Experience: 3 - 5 years of experience in fraud investigations, risk management, or trust & safety, specifically within fintech, banking, or the payments industry.
  • Domain Knowledge: Strong understanding of P2P payment networks (e.g., Zelle, Venmo, CashApp, ACH) and short-term credit/cash advance products.
  • Analytical Skills: Proficiency in data analysis using SQL and Python. Ability to connect the dots across multiple data sources to uncover hidden fraud rings.
  • Problem Solving: A strong analytical mindset with the ability to make high-quality, high-velocity decisions under pressure.
  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex fraud patterns to non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Vendor Experience: Familiarity with modern fraud prevention tools and identity verification vendors.

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.

  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

Working at the intersection of technology and travel, the team is focused on delivering reliable booking experiences and strong partner connectivity across the platform.

As a Senior Data Analyst on the Wholesaler BU team, you'll work at the intersection of product and business analytics on the supply side — the direct contracts we hold with accommodation partners and hotels. You'll dig into our direct inventory, shape prioritization and segmentation, and build the analytics that guide where the business goes next. It's a great fit for a self-driven analyst who can navigate a complex, evolving product, turn messy questions into clear answers, and partner closely with product, commercial, and international supply teams to make real impact.

jobs.excerpt: Who We AreRoots is a wealth-building platform built on a simple belief: everyone deserves a real path to financial growth, and that path should feel achievable.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Roots is a wealth-building platform built on a simple belief: everyone deserves a real path to financial growth, and that path should feel achievable.

We create simple, accessible ways for people to participate in ownership and invest in real assets, making wealth-building more engaging and within reach. Today, Roots is a growing ecosystem that combines an investment platform, financial tools, and education to support long-term financial progress.

We’re already helping a rapidly growing community take meaningful steps toward building wealth, and we’ve seen that when the experience feels intuitive and rewarding, people actually stick with it. That’s what we’re continuing to build.

Why We Need You

As our real estate portfolio has grown to more than 1,500 single-family rental homes across multiple states, we’re building a finance function that reflects the complexity of owning and operating institutional-quality real estate.

This is a new role on our Finance team that will work day-to-day alongside our President of Real Estate, helping bridge finance and operations as we continue to scale. While you’ll report through Finance, you’ll become the primary accounting partner supporting our real estate portfolio.

You’ll own the financial reporting and portfolio accounting for our REIT, sitting at the intersection of property-level accounting and portfolio-level financial reporting. Working closely with third-party property management companies, you’ll ensure accurate, timely, and well-organized financial data that supports internal decision-making, investor reporting, and the continued growth of our portfolio.

This is a highly operational role for someone who enjoys owning monthly close processes, reconciling data from multiple sources, and transforming property management data into clean, standardized financial reporting. You’ll primarily support management accounting and internal reporting while ensuring our books and financial statements remain GAAP compliant.

Role Responsibilities

  • Maintain monthly portfolio schedules, including acquisitions, dispositions, and portfolio changes across our single-family rental portfolio.
  • Maintain accurate accounting records at both the property and portfolio levels.
  • Record and track annual replacement reserves and other portfolio-level adjustments.
  • Serve as the primary accounting contact for third-party property management companies.
  • Collect, review, and reconcile monthly financial information, including rent rolls, income statements, trial balances, invoices, and supporting documentation.
  • Follow up with variance analysis on discrepancies, missing information, and reporting delays to keep month-end close on schedule.
  • Prepare monthly portfolio reporting and consolidated financial statements for internal leadership.
  • Support investor reporting, Regulation A reporting requirements, audits, tax preparation, and other financial reporting needs.
  • Partner closely with the President of Real Estate, acquisitions, and finance teams to ensure portfolio activity is accurately reflected in financial reporting.
  • Prepare journal entries, account reconciliations, and supporting schedules during month-end close.
  • Identify opportunities to improve accounting processes, reporting accuracy, internal controls, and automation as we continue to scale.
  • Perform ad hoc financial analyses and reporting to support operational and investment decisions.
  • Own the accuracy and integrity of portfolio financial data, proactively identifying issues and driving them to resolution.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of accounting experience, preferably within real estate, property management, fund accounting, or a REIT.
  • Strong understanding of property accounting principles and month-end close processes.
  • Experience reconciling and consolidating financial information from multiple external sources.
  • Experience working with residential real estate portfolios, preferably single-family rentals.
  • Familiarity with REIT accounting and financial reporting is preferred.
  • Experience with Yardi, AppFolio, Sage, or similar accounting software is a plus.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, and financial analysis.
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage recurring monthly deadlines.
  • Strong communication skills and confidence working with internal stakeholders and external partners.
  • Highly analytical with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment where priorities evolve.
  • Excited to build new processes and help establish a scalable real estate accounting function.

How We Work

Our values show up in how we work: we take ownership, stay curious, communicate clearly, use resources wisely, treat people fairly, and aren’t afraid to challenge how things have always been done.


At Roots, we're committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals, regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We firmly believe that diversity fuels creativity and innovation, enhancing the quality of our work and the strength of our team. Join us and be part of an inclusive environment where every perspective is valued.

jobs.description:
Our Company

Welcome to Energy Vault® (NYSE:NRGV), a global energy storage and power infrastructure company focused on owning, operating, and enabling resilient, dispatchable energy assets.
Energy Vault’s focus is to deliver reliable, flexible power that supports the evolving needs of modern grids, communities, and large energy users. Since 2024, the Company has centered its strategy on an Independent Power Producer (IPP) model, developing, building, owning, and operating critical energy assets around the world.
Energy Vault operates globally, with headquarters in Westlake Village, California and Lugano, Switzerland, and regional development across North America, Europe, Asia, and Australia. The Company partners with utilities, grid operators, and large energy consumers to deliver infrastructure that strengthens grid reliability, enables renewable integration, and supports long-term energy security.
By combining asset ownership with advanced technologies and integration expertise, Energy Vault is building the next generation of critical energy infrastructure, delivering dependable power when and where it matters most.
Learn more at , explore recent updates in our Newsroom, and connect with us on LinkedIn, X, Facebook, Instagram, Vimeo, or YouTube.

Our Values

We Commit: To Building a Better Future for Earth and All Its Beings.
We Innovate: Cutting Edge Solutions to Accelerate the Unique Energy Aspirations of Our Clients.
We Connect: To Build Genuine Relationships.
We Deliver: Going Above & Beyond by Being Fast & Nimble.
We Lead: With Authenticity and Purpose.

Our Energetic Team:

Energy Vault Solution, a division within Energy Vault, is dedicated to delivering customer-focused energy storage products that merge Battery and Clean Hydrogen technologies. The Energy Vault Solution team also develops and manages our AI/ML powered software applications that include EMS, Lifecycle Management, and Energy Trading Platforms.

Your Impact as a Senior Energy Trading Manager:

Energy Vault is seeking a Senior Energy Trading Manager to lead the day-ahead and real-time energy and ancillary service offers of our utility-scale battery energy storage system (BESS) fleet in ERCOT and CAISO, with scope to expand into additional ISO/RTO markets as our Asset Vault portfolio grows. You will own the trading strategy for our assets — executing offers using Energy Vault’s internal software and forecasting tools, following QSE and Scheduling Coordinator operating procedures, and intervening with manual trading when market conditions call for it.

This is a senior role with broad influence across market analytics, optimization, product, and engineering, reporting to the Head of Optimization & Trading. The successful candidate combines deep market expertise with strong analytical skills to make informed trading decisions, improve bidding strategies, and collaborate with data scientists, software engineers, and asset operations teams to continuously enhance trading performance.

As a seasoned energy trader, you will utilize our internal software and oversee the Day-Ahead (DA) positions to allocate the energy storage capacity between the DA Energy, Real-Time (RT) Energy and Ancillary Service Markets, and monitor RT trades and dispatches.

Your Mission:

  • Establish frameworks and success metrics used to evaluate trading performance; monitor daily performance and risk metrics and communicate results transparently to internal stakeholders and external partners.
  • Participate in physical dispatch and optimization of BESS assets, executing energy and ancillary service offers in the day-ahead and real-time markets using Energy Vault’s internal software and forecasting tools.
  • Oversee day-ahead trading strategy, developing views of market fundamentals to guide the daily allocation of BESS capacity between the Day-Ahead Energy, Real-Time Energy, and Ancillary Service markets.
  • Act as the team’s subject-matter expert on wholesale electricity trading, market fundamentals, bidding strategy, and ISO protocols and operations.
  • Work closely with data scientists, software engineers, and asset operations teams to evaluate and refine Energy Vault’s programmatic optimization and software development; translate analytical findings into product requirements and roadmap priorities.
  • Develop processes and frameworks to identify likely transmission constraints in day-ahead and real-time markets and incorporate those expectations to adjust optimization strategy appropriately.
  • Contribute to Energy Vault’s understanding of appropriate hedging activity to ensure adequate storage revenue over the long term of offtake agreements; potentially execute in futures and options markets for energy price volatility as opportunities arise.
  • Monitor regulatory developments and market design changes across relevant ISOs (e.g., ERCOT RTC+B, CAISO reforms); evaluate their commercial and operational implications and communicate proactively with internal teams.

Your Background:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in engineering, economics, finance, or another quantitative field.
  • 5+ years of power trading experience at a utility, IPP, trading firm, or energy trading software company. Experience in energy storage asset trading is preferred.
  • Deep expertise in ERCOT (including operating protocols and rules) with working knowledge across multiple markets.
  • Deep understanding of transmission topology, ISO LMP and ancillary service pricing, and power flow constraints.
  • Understanding of risk management and ability to maximize revenue subject to risk constraints.
  • Ability to participate in an on-call rotation supporting live market operations and time-sensitive trading decisions, including occasional evening or weekend coverage.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex market dynamics to technical teams, commercial stakeholders, and executive audiences.
  • Strong quantitative and analytical skills, with the ability to interpret complex datasets and translate findings into actionable recommendations; working experience in Python preferred, strong Excel skills required.
  • Experience across one or more financial products (virtuals, CRR/FTR, forward contracts) is a plus.
  • Self-directed, highly organized, and able to manage multiple priorities independently while maintaining analytical rigor in a fast-paced operational environment; embraces a disciplined entrepreneurial culture.
  • Willingness to travel, up to 20%.
  • Comfortable thriving in fast-paced, rapid growth environments.
  • A passion for sustainability, our mission, and our vision is a bonus!
  • Must successfully pass a pre-employment background check.
  • Energy Vault participates in E-Verify.

Join Us in Empowering Change

At Energy Vault we are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants. We believe inclusion creates opportunity for collaborative excellence through diversity of thought. We invite individuals of all genders, races, identities, ethnicities, sexual orientations, national origins, abilities, protected veteran status, religions, educational and socioeconomic backgrounds to explore employment with our organization.
Apply now and become a catalyst for change at Energy Vault!

Job Description:

We are seeking a highly skilled Data Scientist with a strong background in machine learning, data engineering, and model optimization. The ideal candidate should be proficient in Python, PySpark, and SQL, experienced in time series forecasting, feature engineering, and data model performance evaluation, and capable of working with large-scale data integration projects across various domains.
A large part of this role involves building machine learning models that not only meet but exceed user expectations, driving measurable value for the business. The candidate will need to have a strong grasp of data model optimization, feature engineering, and model evaluation metrics to ensure high-performance solutions.
This role also requires experience with cloud platforms, ETL tools, data transformation processes, and working with structured and unstructured data. While not required, familiarity with object-oriented programming languages (C#, Java, JavaScript) is a plus. Strong communication skills are essential for collaborating with cross-functional teams and presenting findings effectively.

Key Responsibilities:

• Develop and optimize machine learning models with a focus on time series forecasting and predictive analytics.
• Perform feature engineering and data model optimization to enhance model accuracy and efficiency.
• Continuously evaluate model performance using metrics such as MAPE, RMSE, R², and adjust strategies accordingly.
• Build and implement data pipelines using PySpark, SQL, and cloud-based solutions for seamless data integration.
• Work on large-scale data integration projects, leveraging tools such as Boomi, SnapLogic, SSIS, or Palantir to extract, transform, and load data.
• Utilize Palantir Foundry, Google Cloud, AutoAI, and Google Colab for data modeling, processing, and automation.
• Design and maintain data warehouse solutions to support advanced analytics and business intelligence.
• Perform complex data transformations using SQL queries and data objects to support AI/ML-driven initiatives.
• Collaborate closely with business stakeholders to ensure models align with user expectations and business objectives.
• Deploy, monitor, and continuously improve machine learning models in production environments.
• Communicate technical findings and insights effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Required Skills & Qualifications:
• Proficiency in Python, PySpark, and SQL for data analysis, feature engineering, and model development.

The Preserve Data Integration Specialist will work across teams within the Leveraging our Lands program to collect, manage and maintain preserve-based infrastructure data and provide technical support in ArcGIS or other relational database technologies to Conservancy staff. The Preserve Data Integration Specialist will be responsible for coordinating with state staff to gather existing data and collect new infrastructure data at a selection of preserves that will be prioritized for visitation. They will perform data analysis; design and produce advanced complex queries and professional reports, process spatial and other relational data sets derived from cartographic and tabular source material and provide hardware/software support. The Preserve Data Integration Specialist will additionally develop and deliver training to staff individually and in groups, produce maps and other graphic products and reports. They develop and maintain GIS library and/or database products library and compiles, assembles, and maintains land protection, biodiversity, and management information from various sources.

The Preserve Data Integration Specialist is a remote position in the United States. The Preserve Data Integration Specialist role will travel in the US is required up to 30% time. In this role, the Specialist will need the ability to traverse various, rugged terrains (from sandy beaches, to roots, and rocks) with slopes >25% as needed.

We’re Looking for You:

Are you looking for a career to help people and nature? Guided by science, TNC creates innovative, on-the-ground solutions to our world’s toughest challenges so that people and nature can thrive together. The person in this role will identify and collect existing field data and conduct field-based infrastructure and accessibility assessments for approximately 150 preserves to be identified in collaboration with the Leveraging Our Lands - Visitor Activation Strategy Team. Infrastructure and Accessibility Assessments will be completed using newly developed ArcGIS online tools and through the Universal Trail Assessment Process. Collaboration with Preserve based staff and volunteers is required. Knowledge of accessibility laws and best practices and the Principals for Equitable Conservation is desired.

Upon completion of the field surveys and/or data collection, the staff person will be responsible for managing data to be used with TNC's Land Asset Management system, by reviewing all points, lines, and polygons, ensuring data quality and accuracy. The person in this position will help create state-level specific Dashboards and Reports to support implementation of Recreational Trail Best Practices and Accessibility Guidelines and Visitor Activation Strategy.

  • MS or BS degree and certification in related field and 3 years related experience, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • Experience managing, maintaining, and populating databases and manual files.

  • Experience with interpretation of image analysis, complex spatial analysis, data modeling and landscape scenario analysis.

  • Experience managing multiple projects.

  • Experience interpreting results then developing and delivering training (if required) to practitioners.

You will serve as both a principal-level technical leader and a trusted customer advocate, ensuring our platform delivers measurable business value while shaping the future direction of our product.

    • Change Data Capture (CDC) technologies

    • Data warehousing (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Delta Lake, PostgreSQL)
    • Kubernetes and distributed systems
    • AI/ML frameworks and analytics platforms (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake, Spark)
  • Experience optimizing system performance and reliability at scale

Communication & Problem-Solving

  • Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to:
    • Translate complex technical concepts into business value for customers
    • Convert business needs into clear technical requirements for product teams
    • Present technical solutions to both engineering and executive stakeholders
  • Strong problem-solving skills and comfort operating in ambiguous, high-impact environments

Travel & Commitment

  • Commitment to building deep, long-lasting customer relationships through consistent engagement

Preferred Qualifications

As a DevOps Engineer at Bullhorn, you'll be building the tools and systems that facilitate large-scale software releases safely and effectively. This includes all pipelines for building, packaging, deploying, and validating software delivery. You will help the team take code changes safely and quickly from a developer's machine all the way to production. We're a release-engineering and platform team: we build and maintain the systems that enable engineering teams to deploy with confidence. We relentlessly automate manual toil from the software delivery lifecycle.

This is a hands-on building role. You'll write automations, own our deploy and CI/CD tooling, containerize and modernize our environments, and partner directly with engineering teams to remove the friction that slows them down.

  • Modernizing build tools across the org to ensure we’re using the latest and greatest technology across all teams.

  • Contributing to documentation, runbooks, and developer enablement so knowledge is shared and not siloed

  • Mentoring teammates, driving conversations about priorities and process, and independently owning complex, cross-cutting initiatives

  • Working within a positive, energizing, collaborative team environment

About the Role

We are hiring a Client Operations Coordinator to support the day-to-day social operations of a major US entertainment client.

Reporting to the Account Manager on the account, you will coordinate the operating rhythm behind the work: content approvals, stakeholder follow-up, meeting preparation, campaign project management, file organisation, episode deliveries, social-account access, and cross-workstream status visibility.

This is not passive administration. The role is about making complex work visible, organised, and dependable. You will know what is moving, what is waiting for approval, who owns the next step, where the latest file lives, and when a blocker needs to be escalated.

You will work across a high volume of moving parts and stakeholders, helping Storm and the client stay aligned as content, campaigns, meetings, approvals, assets, and access requirements move forward.

A significant part of the role is follow-through. You will be expected to chase inputs, maintain accurate trackers, capture decisions clearly, surface risks early, and make sure agreed actions actually happen.

If you enjoy bringing order to fast-moving work involving lots of people, deadlines, systems, and dependencies, this role will suit you well.

About Storm Ideas

Founded in 2008, Storm Ideas is an international team working with globally recognised clients, particularly across the US TV and entertainment industry.

Our work sits at the intersection of media, technology, creativity, and operations. We produce social content at scale, support major entertainment brands, build products, and keep improving how our teams work.

We are a remote-first, fast-moving company with established clients, an international team, and a strong appetite for better tools, better systems, and better ways of working.

We use modern technology, including carefully selected AI-assisted tools, to create clearer workflows, make better decisions, catch problems earlier, and deliver consistently high-quality work.

  • Prepare for recurring meetings, capture decisions and actions, and make sure follow-ups are completed
  • Project-manage smaller social campaigns, maintaining clear timelines, owners, dependencies, approvals, assets, and risks
  • Keep client files, episode deliveries, social-account access, permissions, and related operational processes organised and up to date
  • Maintain shared trackers, calendars, and documentation so priorities, deadlines, blockers, and responsibilities remain visible
  • Chase inputs, surface risks early, escalate blockers appropriately, and keep work moving across multiple teams and stakeholders
  • Keep operational processes, templates, contacts, and handover information current so work is reliable and repeatable

  • Strong organisation across multiple workstreams, deadlines, approval paths, versions, and dependencies
  • High ownership and a proactive approach to keeping work moving
  • Clear written communication and the ability to turn scattered feedback or ambiguous requests into concise actions, owners, and decisions
  • Experience preparing for recurring meetings, producing useful recaps, and following actions through to completion
  • Confidence coordinating high-volume approval workflows involving internal teams, senior stakeholders, legal review, or multiple revision rounds
  • Practical experience with file-management and project-management systems such as Box, Monday.com, Airtable, spreadsheets, or comparable tools
  • Good judgement about when to follow up, when to challenge, when to escalate, and when a decision sits outside your authority
  • A calm and dependable approach when work is late, unclear, blocked, or changing quickly
  • Confidence using modern productivity tools, including AI-assisted tools where appropriate, to prepare, organise, check, and follow through on work
  • Good judgement around checking AI-assisted outputs and handling confidential information carefully

What Success Looks Like

  • Approvals move through the correct stakeholders with accurate statuses, complete feedback, and no lost decisions
  • Meetings are properly prepared, decisions are clearly documented, actions have owners, and follow-up happens without repeated prompting
  • Campaign teams can quickly see the latest milestones, assets, versions, risks, approvals, and delivery status
  • Client and agency teams trust the operational picture because updates are clear, details are accurate, and blockers are raised early
  • Episode deliveries, files, account access, and recurring operational tasks are organised and dependable
  • Important context carries cleanly between Storm and client meetings rather than being lost between teams

  • You do not wait for someone else to notice that something is slipping; you identify it, make it visible, and help drive it towards resolution

This Role Will Suit You If

  • You enjoy the operational side of social and campaign work: coordination, approvals, meetings, systems, timing, and follow-through
  • You like bringing order to work that spans many people, tools, and deadlines
  • You are naturally good at keeping track of details without losing sight of the bigger picture
  • You communicate warmly and clearly while still being willing to chase, challenge, and escalate

What It's Like To Work Here

Modern Tech Stack
We use modern collaboration, file-management, project-management, social-platform, password-management, and AI-enabled workflow tools to support our teams and clients.

This is a dedicated, embedded role working closely with both Storm Ideas and client stakeholders. You will work with the Account Manager, strategy leads, production teams, and other client and agency stakeholders, with clear escalation routes for decisions and approvals.
